text: Initially downloaded this because it was on Nectar Arcade. absolutely loved it. However I am now on level 56. There have been 5 incidents of having to pay in-game coins to unlock buildings which then just come with an 'update coming' message. The last one costing 30k, and it takes absolutely ages to earn the coins because the replenish of energy is slow, the orders take 2/3 days to complete if not spending real life money. Fun for early levels, but now feels like a chore.

I wouldn't usually play anything like this but I decided to try something different, it's an amazing idea with one drawback - running out of energy. It limits how much you can play unless you fancy paying out a lot, even with free energy from Facebook links, very frustrating. Why can't you just buy these games outright and have fun? Oh yes, wouldn't be as profitable, so disappointing because it's a super game and brilliant idea. I'll still play it, when I have a couple of minutes in the day.

recent upgrade ruined the game! it's now not fun the play. they've made it more difficult to complete challenges. they've taken away items from free producers which don't cost energy and now instead of these recharging in 20 mins they now take 60 mins!!! so now you have to wait 3 times as long and the rewards are less. I feel like they're making it harder because they want people to spend money. well I won't be one of them! after this review I'm deleting the app.

Giving it four stars. The game is fun, without unwanted ads, but after you've reached more than about level 10, the max energy level of natural recharge, 100, becomes too little to get anything done, and it takes too long to recharge. It's still fun, with a nice art style, but it's very slow.

I downloaded it via Nectar, it was ok at first, you could make progress, now seems like if you don't spend money, and I mean loads and loads of money then you are stuck. Not rewarding anymore, challenges expire after a short while, has basically become a waste of time attempting if you are not going to spend money. I for one am not, I am already spending a lot of time on it. Nectar points won't make the spend required. If it wasn't for Nectar would have uninstalled by now.

I like the game but increasingly it takes many clicks just to get playing - about 20 windows to close because I don't want to buy in game packs, or forcing me to take part in races, to let me know events have finished, events have started, events are ongoing. It is too much! I just want to start playing! (upped to a 4 star for quick response to my review!)

I enjoy playing this game but it is also incredibly frustrating that it is basically impossible to get anywhere in events without an in app or loyalty club purchase, even then its still difficult regardless of the cost of the purchase. I'm about to crash out of temple adventure at the last hurdle again because I have run out of energy & gems, so I can't complete the last order, it's totally pants in that respect. I get that they need to make money, but I don't have a money tree either!

I have REALLY enjoyed this game for years, lately I'm starting to get very exhausted with it. A major problem I have experienced is there is a large imbalance with the energy it takes to complete orders and the money reward you get for the order. An order will reward $24k but it will take 300+ energy to complete it. Then to improve the town, it will cost $200k so it takes a long time to progress. Update: Clicked through 20 pop-ups before even getting to play. UGH.

You know it's going to be a grift! The first levels fly by and are really enjoyable. But as you continue you then discover that for the higher level items which may or may not drop. you can easily expend 300 energy to create. Its then the drift as in app purchases are ridiculously high for the amount of energy you need. My advice play 15 to 20 levels and then uninstall unless you want to splash out large sums of money for a tedious, pathetic reward. It truly is a shame they chose profit instead.

Great game, want to give it a 5 but not until the bug is fixed with the ads. If you get an ad that requires you to hit the Google play link, then just know you won't get your reward because if you go to any other screen Travel Town starts over. So to pop a bubble, just either don't or pay the gems, because you are going to have to watch 2 to 6 ads to get the ad that doesn't redirect you anywhere. Thought it would have been fixed by now, seems to be a common issue for several games.

Good, but not great. The item producers are not random. They will produce less of the items you need if it is in your list of things to fulfill. Example: Carpenters station. If you need to build wooden block puzzles the producer will generate more toy items (tops & yo-yos) at about a 2:1 ratio because you can't use them, so you use more energy to try produce the items you need. Your energy is finite unless you spend real money to get more which is obviously the point.

Totally gutted to discover that I have lost all my progress, plus almost 1000 in energy, plus extras I had bought, following the update 5 days ago. Logged in today to discover the game has put me back at level 1!!! I have been so enjoying this game, but I simply don't have the heart, patience or interest in repeating multiple levels for a second time. Plus, whilst building up my levels over the past year, I have spent a fair amount of money on extras. I feel I have been totally scammed!

Great game overall. However, every time I want to have a quick check-in, I am bombarded with pop-ups. It's a bit infuriating having to speed press the quit button, just to stop all the useless pop ups. Also, the forced participation in events like races really makes me not want to engage. Give the players more freedom to choose when to participate. Because I get 10 minutes of play time, get forced into a competition, then lose it because I can't dedicate more time

One of the few puzzle games that's kept my attention recently. I do find some aspects a little tedious (such as the producers that make mini-producers, etc.), but the optional ads are a good way of getting rewards/more energy etc. without being too in your face. There is a little bit of money-grabbing but in today's mobile games market that's to be expected. One suggestion I do have is the option to remove the 'bubble' optional duplicate items. When your board is nearly full they're a pain!

was fun until like level 25 to 30, then it gets way out of hand, the orders are getting way to high and some of the ingredients are way too rare for such little energy, only get to play for like 1 minute every 2 hours, you can also forget any challenge orders, you won't be completing those unless paying to win along with several other challenges the time limit is way too short.

it's great till around level 30, then it gets impossible to complete orders as you don't have enough energy, even with the free energy through the travel card app. you'll get about 5mins of play time before running out + you won't be any nearer to completing an order. I've even bought diamonds + packs just to continue playing, which I'm guessing is what they want you to do due to the amount of pop ups.. I'm growing impatient with the game and am not prepared to spend anymore money on it..

The pop ups when you open the game are ridiculous. 10 or more and sometimes right in the middle of merging. Also being forced to race and do challenges is frustrating. I have zero desire to do them. I just want to merge and pick what I want to participate in. Not be forced to. I do not need pop ups to keep me updated on events. I am smart enough to look at the screen on the left to see them, or go to the second screen and see everything. Most of the pop ups are to buy something.

the wait is too long to get more lives. makes the game boring. i persevered thinking i might get more energy in higher up levels, even with extra energy from social media links, and watching the max 4 videos a day, its still frustratingly slow to progress. 100 energy lasts a few seconds on some days i cant fulfill any orders. actually would improve if you could watch more adds for more energy.

this game was fun but they changed it too much. whether it's the graphics, what the producers drop, &now they changed the fact that you're able to control when using a prize booster, the little changes make the game confusing and less enjoyable. it's also hard to progess,process,, you can sell 1 item for 45k then it'll be ordered again for half of that, along with a whole other item that would've sold for 45k. lol its really stupid... was fun but now it feels like a chore, had to delete.

The game is really fun up to about level 25 then it slows down dramatically. I can only play for about ten minutes before I run out of energy, which means I only end up playing this a couple of times throughout the day. It takes me days to complete just one order. It takes weeks to level up any of my buildings, and you can forget any challenges because they refresh so fast you won't get anywhere near winning anything at all. I've never won the weekly top prize for completing achievements.

Paid for more energy which I didn't use by the end of the day. Nowhere did it say that the energy would reset down to the basic 100 overnight, so they've basically stolen that money from me. I was loving this game up until that point, that's really put me off from playing it. Money grabbing like the rest of them. I won't be paying for anything again and as it gets harder to play the game with the free energy I'll probably stop playing altogether pretty soon.

Very disappointed — not because of difficulty, but because of unfair mechanics and dismissive support.I spent days merging items to complete my final star task. When I finally got the last required item, it highlighted as ready to submit. As I clicked it, a sudden pop-up appeared with the same item, and it redirected there instead of completing my task. My progress stayed at 11/12, meaning all that effort was lost. Support claimed they “found nothing unusual,” which felt like a complete dismissa

New changes are awful. I'm a long time player and have invested a lot of time and money into this game. Lately it feels like the creators have gotten greedy. Tickets barely give any energy. Prizes are hard to come by even if you spend money. The side quests are pointless, unattainable rewards. It's making me lose interest in the game.

This is a merge game. Nothing like the advert for the game. Another game to grab your money for energy. If the gameplay were like the advert, it potentially could be a great game. As it is, it's just another merge boring game. Would not recommend any game, the developers mislead, with FAKE adverts.

Started off as fun but now its getting very boring, amount of coins to buy location is getting astronomical,you spend coins & then get message something special coming soon (coins could have been spent elsewhere) still waiting for it to come. Very unlikely to get just 1 full set of cards but you will get 2,3,4 of the same card.

Initially I found this app really fun and it still is. But it is very addictive and it pulls you in to spend so much money without you even realising. I've also found lots of glitches in the app that have to do with the ads. Sometimes when I watch an ad I click the X and it just kicks me out of the app and I never get my reward, the app freezes and kicks me out a lot and every time I wash an advert I barely ever get the reward after it because it always glitches.

This game takes your money! After spending real money to purchase rubies and energy then spending energy to merge what you need the item will suddenly disappear from the board 😡 very annoying! I won't be spending anything else on this game and will just wait the time limit for more energy! I worked for 3 days to get the eel then suddenly I log in today and it's gone from my game board 😡

I enjoyed this game for a while. The ads are minimal and they give you a fair amount of free in game currency, so you're not totally missing out if you don't want to spend money. BUT... the energy system isn't balanced. As you progress the orders start taking a ton of energy to fulfill, but you're still capped at 100 energy. Increasing the limit with every level seems like an obvious solution, but for now it's too tedious and slow to enjoy anymore.

This is a fun game until you reach the higher levels. I'm on level 47, and the items literally take days to complete. I finally completed an order for 2,500 coins and didn't even get the credit. It just continued to load, so I closed the app, opened it again, and it had sent it but didn't give me the coins. I'm about to uninstall this game. Overall, it really is a fun game until you get to the items that take forever to complete. The graphics are also awesome.

It's a fun game that gets pretty boring once you hit level 25 or so. I am currently at level 30, and you run out of energy so quickly that there is really no way to complete multiple orders per day anymore. Sometimes you can get lucky and complete a couple to get you to progress, but I find it near impossible to fully complete the daily challenges anymore as your level gets higher. they really want you to spend money which is why you'll get at least 3 popups before you can even play.

I initially downloaded this to farm Atlas bucks but I was surprised to find how addictive this game really is. However, past level 30, the game is almost unplayable without paying real money. Completing any order takes at least several hundred energy so you could go days before having enough energy to complete one or two orders without spending money. I can't even imagine how slow the game progression must be for like level 50+. The fun quickly becomes a boring grind for almost no rewards.

Good game, except it's hardly enjoyable unless you spend money on it. So I tried doing that. The thousands of energy bought could only last a few minutes, maybe an hour. I spent over CA$100/month, found out that the "prizes" for the events are nowhere near the amount of energy I'd spend to get that prize. ANY event. Daily, weekly, month/s long events all have extremely underwhelming prizes. NOT WORTH IT AT ALL. Want to play for free? You'd play only 2 mins for every 3 hours and 20 minutes.

Really hard game to enjoy. Nobody makes games you can just sit and play, there's always something annoying in the way. In this instance it's waiting for everything to recharge before you can continue playing. Tried to sit and enjoy this but deleted after one day because I kept running out of energy and having to wait until later to play again. Not what people are looking for.

it would be really nice if gameplay went further. another problem is when you choose x4 it always comes out as times 3 with random bits of other things. the button says x4 you should honor that. and because gameplay does not go very far along with this complete jipping I wouldn't feel safe making purchases. in fact I'd feel pretty ripped off.

This game is fun until you have to pour real money into it to advance or get the items you need. Your energy is depleted very quickly but takes hours to reload (unless you want to pay money for more). The events are fun if you can actually get energy to play. Again, if you spill really money into it, you're golden.

I was getting on well with this game but now I've hit a wall. To reiterate what others have said it just takes ages to get anywhere. I'm on level 21 and I'm bored now. I need loads of building supplies and work ages for a tool box that generates 6 items and still don't have what I need. It annoys me when it says I'm "LUCKY" to receive the item the first two merge into. Luck would be the finished item given to me on a plate!

It's fine. Way too many pop ups though. And way too many bubbles generated by merges which take up space on the board. Plus props randomly need recharging at odd times. Eg, you'll open the game for the first time that day, tap something twice, and it will need to recharge (net and pub sign are the worst for this). Cool down is very quick though, it's just annoying rather than hindering gameplay.

Gets tedious way too fast (~level 30). You're not given nearly enough energy to do more than one or two tasks in a day, and definitely not enough to finish the daily quests (why call them "daily" tasks if it's impossible to do in a single day?). It's glitchy too, with things like perpetual loading and orders being unable to be filled. The storyline is inoffensive, no drama or any kind of plot, which can be a pro or a con. Overall could be fun but needs a lot of balancing and bug fixes.

I surprisingly thoroughly enjoy this game. However, recently it keeps crashing. Like constantly. And I'll have to redo everything I did prior to the crash and it's getting so bad that I'm nearly tempting to just uninstall the game cause what's the point of having it if I can't play it more than 4-5 minutes at a time?

I enjoy this game and I'm glad there aren't a lot of popups wanting me to buy stuff, but I play a similar game that has a boost mode which is super helpful so it's disappointing this one doesn't have that. I have to spend multiple days clicking the same source to get even one high level item. I'm going to stop playing this one and play that one instead after a while.

enjoyable game, but. . . . SO MANY POP UPS!! Why. why in the actual world do i need to click through on average 6-10 pop up windows when I open the game. juat let me play the game. Its actually annoying to me that I have to do that EVERYTIME. Just let me get into the game, and enjoy what I want. besides that its an enjoyable game, I also just wish they would let energy go and not cap at 100, it would be nice to come back after like 2 or so days and have 400 energy to use.

I loved this game up until a few days ago. Ever since I updated the app on July 16, 2025, I've been having lots of problems with the game freezing up after playing for a few minutes. And sometimes, the game doesn't start up properly. I have been reluctant to uninstall then reinstall as I fear losing my progress in the game.

The game is fun, but after reaching level 16, I have noticed there are far too many pop-ups. If I press the 'X' button, I don't want the same pop-up to show. I pressed X, which means I'm not interested in whatever you're offering, I don't then want to press X 7 more times. That in itself makes me not want to play anymore. It's annoying.

as with all merge games, this one was awesome for a while. I hate being forced to do the races and extras. Energy doesn't last long enough. The items you need constantly have to recharge . I'm done. I'll spend my time on a game that is actually fun for more than a month.

honestly I don't tend to like playing these types of merging games but this one has me hooked. it's so fun and you can unlock so many different things really. my only bad thing is the energy does run out quite quickly and takes a little long to recharge but otherwise it's a fun game and great for if you just want some alone time!

Such a fun and clever game, I'm obsessed! The merges are varied and creative, and it keeps things extra interesting by throwing in bonus and surprise items during play. Plus the game is generous with its energy and diamonds, making me feel super lucky, never frustrated! Also, shout-out to the amazing support team: I had a request and the response was swift and complete in no time!! Awesome game and awesome support and no snark about ads or purchases - just the best all-around!

Installed, played 1 round, then couldn't get anywhere. No hints, no options, there was nothing to do. Nothing to merge with, no option to do anything to add anything to merge with. Don't bother. Game developer should know you can't do anything on a board if there's nothing to merge with. Only bucket available. Everything else is locked. So literally just move around and can't go back, add boosts, nothing. Worthless
Yay you've made it easier to get things! Thank you. Great merge game. Can't fault it.

I was really enjoying playing the game! I even made an in app purchase! Something I never done on any game before. For some reason, everytime I open it, it freezes and closes. EDIT: Back to 5🌟 rating! I was able to fix the game. Somehow my background data got turned off, once I turned back on, game play back to normal! Edit: On 7/2/26: I was able to reach my goal of Level 40! (Without more In-app purchases) It can be done! & I will continue to play the game still, I really enjoyed it that much!

It's a good game but the beginning popups are many and annoying. Also, it seems as if the events end as soon as they start. Start an event, doze off, wake back up and then poof, here's your twenty energy for playing. Also, I only signed up for this game with the promise of getting money for downloading, which, was a scam! Rebuttal: there is now way to miss out on events when especially when they have been tagged with a red, visual dot.

I think it@s kind of ridiculous that it takes so much energy for 1 tap of a source item. Every other merge game is 1 tap = 1 energy. I kept wondering how I was running out of energy so quickly. Also, there are waaaayyy too many pop-ups as soon as you open the game. Then 50 more when you run out of energy. It is really annoying. That combined with the amount of energy used for 1 tap males me want to uninstall this game.

With Generators that can generate 2 or more items, why is it that sometimes that specific item won't come even with 400+ energies, that's ridiculous. Also way tooo many pop ups, it's irritating when time is running out and you wanna rush with some orders too. From 3 to 2, I'm lowering my rating. Also for card trades, it's outrageous to have 10+ same cards even golden cards while you cannot get a new one after opening 10 packs of cards

Been enjoying the game since 3 months! Filling the picture album has been the most thrilling of them all. Recently noticed that the close option is not shown after finishing an ad, but in travel card and travel town game app. I have to close them completely and start over to get out of the ad. Hope this will be fixed soon for smooth gameplay.

Game play is fun but then you get adds to pop bubbles but then instead of the bubble popping the game resets or it freezes to where you can't use your gems to pop it either and only unfreezes after it pops on its own and disappears! Completely forcing you to pay to continue to play or wait. As a once paying player, I won't be sending another dime! This is bogus AF. I will update if I ever get a response.

They changed the Dream Quest. I like it better now. I was fleeced by the spinning energy wheel on an event because it was on 100 Energy and it immediately switched over to 20 even though it doesn't do that any other time it's hovering on something. So, just know that the gold tier prize is probably programmed to be unobtainable. Other than that, I actually think the game has gotten better.

this game could be really fun, but I can only enjoy it for about 20 minutes before I run out of energy and then spend the rest of the day checking to see if I can combine something. I spend too much time staring at the timer waiting for another energy to drop lol. I hate to delete it, because it's a great concept, but there's no way to make decent progress without spending tons of real money.

they just want your money. first of, once you start playing and get over their "love bombing" easy progress, free energy from all directions...you cant go anywhere without a purchase. I doneloaded because I was getting paid through freecash and stayed because it was enjoyable. now, not so much. everytime I open the app I have to close 6 in game pop ups suggesting purchases. leveling up is painstakingly slow. its just not enjoyable anymore amd so ill be deleting after having played 56 levels.

it used to be more fun. lately the app has become nothing but clicking for sales, events and other things. most the time, I have to click 8 or more times to get to the main board, and then I could play. more than once, I had to click over 13 times to play. then, you start tapping out energy and then ANOTHER screen pops up. I still play from time to time, but I have moved on to other games

It's really annoying to have to close the same promotion banners over and over again when opening the game. It would help to have a "don't show again" or "don't show again today" button. It's gotten to the point where the game keeps crashing on me. Not a bad game. Pretty addicting actually. It just loses stars when I can't play it.

This game should be called "Uh oh, something went wrong" because it's the most common thing I see. Sure, the ads are voluntary, but when you try watching a video to earn something, it doesn't work 9 times out of 10. Bam Something Went Wrong. Other games I play give the reward anyway, but in this one, you just lose it. It's just really frustrating and makes everything take So Much Longer, especially when you're not a pay-to-play gamer.

I really love this game. This is actually the first game I've ever spent money on. From the main merge games, side quests, to the competitive competitions it's all good. Graphics and themes are good. My main problem is the crashing and slow everything moves. Even starting the game takes a minute to start. I'm not sure if it's just my phone, but my sister has it on her phone and it works just fine. This is just how much this game I made her download it too.

too many pop-ups, it has killed the game. I actually can't play it as it hangs on one of the pop-ups. Update: contacted support because the game was freezing and informed them that I couldn't play, and their solution was to give me a whopping 50 energy that I can't use because the game is frozen. So logical. I deleted my app data and restarted the game. I couldn't recover my progress, even the new game was freezing and being jerky. Delete before you get invested.

liked the game in the beginning but quickly realized it's a cash grab. too many events happen in a short span of time, a few hours, 1-3 days that is sometimes impossible to finish any of the weekly missions. also something I've noted recently is there's ai being used for the artworks. you can tell by how blurry it is compared to the previous illustrations, especially with the new loading screen, the outfits are so low quality compared to the characters and the patterns are nonsensical.

The game is really a fun game, but the thing Thai gets to me is, if you go to another screen, it changes for busy a second, the game has to reboot all over again- and go through each pop up. Seems you have to close out pop up after pop up just to start on the game board. Another thing to build in the town the cost is Crazee expensive. To accommodate coins get crazy. I know the game is free , but everybody don't have the extra to just buy and pay for the extra.

Same experience as every other review I've read. Was fun to begin with but energy is spent far too quickly, without the pay off. It takes far too long to achieve any real results at higher levels and the constant pop ups are infuriating. The generators are terrible. I HATE the items you need to get through other items (the boat, the stationary cupboard, the garden shed etc). The amount of energy spent on those is absurd. Tried to hold out, but am deleting app now.

This game is very fun and kind of addictive. The early stages are easier, but later on it can become frustrating and boring because you can spend 1,000 energy on a single order and still take two days to finish one task. The game always seems to make the goals difficult to reach, which can make you frustrated and tempted to impulsively buy energy or diamonds. So far, I've only broken even. I originally started playing for fun and to make some money, but I've ended up spending too much!

this game is literally forcing the players to pay with money. if you play this game for free, good luck, because one order could take days to complete. They also don't really reward the players who log in dilligently with something worthy. Also, the pop ups for the in-game purchase are pretty annoying. it's almost like they want you to misclick and ended up buying the product. this game should make "do not show me again" tickbox on the bottom of their ad.

It's fine. It would be fun, except you can only play it for maybe 1-2 minutes at a time every few hours. Merging requires "energy", and you only get 100 energy points every 2 hours. You can't even fulfill one "order" with 100 points once you get past level 20. The only reason I still play it is for the Pogo points. There are much better games out there in this wheelhouse.

im level 46 now, y'all all know that the energy isn't balanced already. I'm leaving this review because while fun, the pop up messages are so excessive that combined with orders taking multiple days at my level.. I'm getting annoyed at this point. the only thing that keeps me playing is my friend who I trade cards with. I don't see myself playing in a few months with how the energy doesn't scale, at this point. I'll eventually forget to open the app because of how long everything takes.

I only downloaded this game via Walmart and felt like I met the required level within so many days to get a $75 reward. I haven't seen it. Anyway, I wasn't happy playing it. You have to wait hours to get a full 100 energy, and that can be gone within 5 minutes of playing, making competing with other players a joke. Accumulating "cards" is pointless. Trying to meet some of the orders is futile. You use the camera icon to create "paintings" or "sculptures". You're at the mercy of whatever is given

I love this game that it is so addictive, but the pop ups during the game is annoying. Also it takes a very long time to try to complete at least one album without you trying to exchange with someone. The game gets alot challenging and boring when you get to 30+ because you spend over 24 hours trying to make an order by spending so much energy that you dont even get some of the stuff for that particular order to merge. please try to resolve this. I dont want to lose taste for this game. 😩

the game is cute but to open it, you have to exit out of no less than 12 pop-ups. I counted. the average is 15 and once I had to exit out of 20. and this is EVERY time you open the game. the balloon rise doesn't pop up until youre almost out of energy. sometimes it waits until you've used over 100. the daily prizes give you 8-12 energy. its pittances. its the gambling style where they give you a little here and there so that you spend. I have more to say but character limit

I love this game. Unlike other merge games I've tried its always new and fun. There are only a few little side games that sometimes repeat which can get boring. The only big complaint is that it's expensive to play because you have to keep buying energy as it only lasts for a few minutes. Even loyalty club doesnt give you anything.

The game was enjoyable until we lost all progress. My mother's account was Level 74, but after a forced reinstall due to a game freeze, Google Play Games could not restore the account and only shows a "Try Again" error. The account is now back to Level 5. Losing months of progress like this is extremely frustrating. Please help recover the account.

better than other merge games I've tried but holy heck, enough with the pop ups! I have to click through 20 pop ups just to even get to the game. it almost comes off as begging it also sucks when all the orders are only for the rarest items and the generators REFUSE to pop them out so the board gets filled with nonsense that you know you'll need only once you've thrown it away. that said, it is pretty generous with coins, energy, and diamonds.

Poorly balanced, you need way more energy than you can feasibly get. Insane number of pop-ups for events (which are numerically impossible to win if you're ftp, even if you stockpile a lot of resources ahead of time by skipping out on other events) and other micro transactions. Every time I open the game I spend way too long closing out of pop-ups, which in some cases trigger tutorials I've seen a dozen times already and can't opt out of. And then they KEEP appearing during play, it's maddening.

I’ve had this game since 2024, and somehow it just keeps getting worse. Recently, they even removed the 3 daily diamonds you used to get as a reward after completing a certain number of merges per day. Basically, you only get those 100 ⚡️ and maybe 3–4 sets of 25 more by watching ads — and that’s it. For everything else, they expect you to pay. I’ve honestly never seen such greedy developers. One proof of that: I’ve only managed to pass 86 levels in all this time…

SO SLOW... why does it have to take so much to make an order. I get to play this for a few minutes a day because I run out of energy so quick and it takes FOREVER to get it back. Rewards are imbalanced as well. This game was made by an amateur. Update over a year later: no improvement. I deleted it and came back recently. Now they have challenges that aren't obtainable because you just don't get far with one run of energy. The automated "responses" are very unhelpful FYI.. respond to your issues

I love this game, but I may have to uninstall it. I can't launch the "Discovering Peru" part of the game anymore. I moved to zone 2, and suddenly, the game stopped responding. All the hand trowel I won isn't showing either, I didn't get my rewards either. Completed 3 star sets in a row, and I'm about to complete the 4th, still nothing. Sent a message to support severally, and the issue still persists. Kindly fix this.

I love this game and the graphics! I started to play it to earn money on an app, then decided to keep it. I just wish that the main merge board would change sceneries instead of the same one being displayed, it would be even more pleasant to enjoy. I get buying "extras" but if I don't pay for more energy, it takes me days at a time to fill a single order. I get the challenge and nothing is free, but I just personally feel like we should get more than 100 energy, especially with higher levels that use more of the max items. I use games as an anxiety reducer and for daily dopamine (ADHD) hard to reduce anxiety in 2 mins lol. My problem, I know.

The newest update kind of killed it for me. I was okay checking back multiple times a day to use energy and complete orders, slow going, but still progress. With the new update, there are more steps added for each merge. Getting a full oxygen tank isn't even possible with 100 energy and I have to use that to get the items I actually need. I really hope there is another update with positive changes for the players because I do like the game, but it's becoming unplayable.

After more than a week of playing, I would give it a 3 star only. Pros: I love this game, and graphics are nicely done. It really keeps you engaged and playing for a while. Cons: The higher the level you reach, the harder it is to complete the daily task. You will eventually need lots of energy, which the only way you can have is if you buy. They do provide you some free energy via Facebook -25 energy and 25 x 4 by watching ads. I wish there's other ways to get more energy like side games.

Just normal merge game with normal story. But if you are free player, then dont get your hopes up. You won't be able to finish most of its daily challenge and event without paying gem. Or if you saving up a gem for weeks, maybe you can beat some daily challenges.. when you reach high level, its become a little frustrating when the quest need a few days to complete, and when its done, they just give the same quest.

It was somewhat enjoyable. But I am very upset, because I had to merge 100+ items to make one for a mission. When giving it to the person to complete the mission, it said Connection Lost! After reopening the game, the item is GONE but the mission is not completed. I merged for a long time and spent lightning bolts to get the items to merge, just to disappear into thin air! I will likely not be playing this game much longer. It turned out to be a major waste of time in this case.

I really enjoyed this game. Not 5 stars worthy though: It gets a little stressful with how many objects you have to juggle, you end up having to delete objects just for the sake of space, and you really must watch ads or pay too have enough energy to do anything productive. But the vibe is cute and simple, it's satisfying to merge things, and you can play for free and still enjoy the game.

It's a good game, very fun and enjoyable. But they make it way too difficult to get orders done. And the daily challenges. I get it they want people to spend money and buy energy and diamonds. But that's completely unfair. The orders and daily challenges should be achievable. Also, the cards. I get new packs every day & NEVER get new cards. They make it impossible to complete albums. They would get more people playing the game & possibly spending money if they made things more achievable!

1. Energy gets used up too fast. Sometimes I can use it up in 2 minutes, & then I have to stop playing unless I pay money. It takes 2 hours to fill up your energy. 2. When you don't need an item, the game spawns a lot of them. When you do need an item, it doesn't spawn much of them. It gets frustrating as hell with large orders. You end up needing 400 or so energy sometimes. 3. Hard to collect all the cards. Even if you trade with a friend. My friend and I always need the same cards.

I absolutely love this game. It's a great way to relax. Unfortunately the amount of energy and the time it takes to regenerate, doesn't allow for very much continous play without having to spend money. Update: It's now gotten even more expensive to play for more than a short time. The little $2.99 packages have turned into $7.99 "deals". It's officially making this game a play for 5mins at a time multiple times a day instead of a relax for awhile game. Disappointing cause it's a fun game.

What is the disconnect between the marketers and the developers that they would create a game that looks enticing in the ad, because I'm viewing an advanced level. And yet when I download and install the game I have to go through these ridiculously slow, beginner level tutorials that I can't dismiss! In this game, I can't even turn off the annoying music!No thank you. Later... please take my comments to heart. There's advertising out there that speaks to this issue from other companies.

Don't make the mistake of getting hung on it, it is a very short period while it's enjoyable, unless you plan to pay a lot. I've never seen a game where previously complicated processes are made to have double the steps. I was fed up already with the required steps/energy provided, but this is the last drop. If you are greedy, at least make more content, don't try to squeeze more out of the old. Finally free, just uninstalling it.

This game is very fun to play WHEN IT WORKS. This game would not stop shutting down while I was playing. And any time I tried to watch a video, for either more moves or to help within the game, it would shut down. I even tried to keep playing hoping it was just a one time thing, I do understand most games have issues, but it never stopped. So frustrating.

I used to love this game, and unlike most, I would buy energy to keep going, to reach goals to win big rewards. However, they became very stingy with the "buy a chance to win big energy" offers and ALWAYS rewarded lowest amount. It's truly NOT WORTH the money. Once you'd buy credits, the items would not generate the full award. I'd find myself spending 3 times the amount than just buying it outright from the 'store'. AVOID THE TRAP.

I've been playing this game diligently for many months now. It was genuinely fun, however, apart from the issues other players have mentioned, I've been very disappointed with the rewards. I've hit level 169 already and the level up rewards weren't worth the hard work I put in. Low level chests and 100 energy? Energy easily gets used up. And the low level chests will require me to level up more times just so I can merge it to its maximum level for maximum profit. I quit. The fun is gone.

The game has been great in shorter bursts of maybe up to 30min, so I've stuck with it and made it to level 70, but now with the recent update I cannot play for more than 5min at a time. I need more energy but the bubbles only give coins, which I have over 200k of already so they just become annoying as anything. Thinking with the changes I'll be quitting... Was a good thing for a little while

I got SO MANY obnoxious ads for this game but I guess once in a while, you really find a gem amongst all these sh*tty mobile games. The ads are few and far between, the art is absolutely top notch and the story is just so lovely! Just a group of people trying to restore their beloved island. The game works really well and it's been entertaining me through at least 5 weeks of burnout. I love it!!

I really enjoyed playing this game. I wish there were ways to get more energy without paying for it or waiting. I feel the farther you get in the game the harder it is and makes the game less interesting. Passing levels doesn't happen as often, completing tasks become impossible without spending money to buy more energy and the money you get for completing orders takes forever to accrue to update and move on in the story line. After level 25 it almost isn't fun anymore.

The game has been pretty good and I don't have issues waiting for the supplier recharge. But recently, and I don't know if it's a bug or not, I have been getting inifinte charge on some of the suppliers. This makes it difficult to work on multiple orders at once since there is no energy limit before you run out of energy on one supplier.

I love this game HOWEVER being level 65 and still only getting 100 max energy is impossible to beat the daily challenges without spending money. I think when you level up, especially being at a higher level, you should get more max energy. Also, the new update with the changes in the look of the items I am not a fan of. It looks a little too childish. If it ain't broke, don't fix it. I honestly may take a break for awhile because of the new look.

This game is enjoyable. However, it frustrating that there's no daily bonus. Most frustrating is you rarely get pink diamonds unless you pay for them. You get a few as a reward but nowhere near what is needed. At the moment, to clear a stage or upgrade, you have to sometimes do 1/4, 2/4, 3/4 and only recieve rewards when you have completed 4/4. For some of them, you have to pay over 20,000 in coins. So that's 20,000 x 4. Would be nice of developers to reward users especially in higher levels

Energy is depleted in minutes, yet takes hours to reload. Once you get past about level 30 or so it becomes so difficult to progress and kills motivation. Currently on level 49, and it now takes a few weeks just to fill enough orders to make one upgrade. Also, if you keep steadily progressing, the orders rarely get you to the point where you can complete the highest item. Leaving collections incomplete is infuriating. Edit: Unistalling. New update takes all complaints and makes it worse.

I really enjoyed this game when I first downloaded it. I actually spent a lot of cash on it, which I typically don't do. What has made me give this a 1 star was the addition of the pottery wheel. You have to use SIX energy to get one item. Half the time you get damaged property which takes FOUR energy to remove (you can't just delete it). So half the time you are using 10 energy for no items. That is absolutely ridiculous and shows this company does not care about the players.

EDIT: I had a quick bit of quiet between soccer practice and dentist appointments and GRABBED it. Three for three for extended recharges. I have PLENTY of energy but can't play. I'm out, I don't have time to waste waiting for your clock to run out for no reason. I understand player energy levels but it's frustrating when you finally get a minute to play and everything hits it's 'refresh' time and I can't play after all.

Disappointed. I've been playing this game like an addict for a month now. I even got a friend hooked and we've been playing together. Well her game has been giving her lots of energy and chests to help her keep progressing and mine is now giving me only coins in the bubbles when it used to be energy. I thought it might be the game glitching. So I reinstalled it, and lost 12 levels and the extra storage space that I had bought with my gems... I am quite frustrated and may stop playing now.

Beware! Highly addictive with very expensive packages that bombards you countless time. Would have been an amazing game and so much fun if not costing an arm, a leg, and a kidney. The prices are absolutely ridiculous for the little energy you get, and you can not finish any task without spending at least 20-30 eur each time. I would probably be still spending in this game if the packages would be better priced and allow me to have more than 30 seconds of fun.

This is an extremely addictive game. The only things that should be corrected are: make both items thst come from one thing equally available, i.e: items to create a picture and items to create a statue. You get more picture merge items much more often than the statues. This fills up the board with much unnecessary items. Also, there needs to be a way to get more energy than just the gems, because the gems are not readily available either. I won't spend money on games.

As far as merge games go, this is one of the cuter ones, in my opinion. But I feel like I'm cursed - As soon as I spend money in a mobile game, I either run into a wall or discover something about it that kills the game for me. With Travel Town, it's the pottery wheel mechanic. 4-5 energy (which is already limited) per item with a chance at trash that takes 3-4 energy just to clear from the board. My game has grinded to a halt since I unlocked this feature. Such a shame.

I can't say I like this game one bit, since nothing about this game is like the one advertised. It basically forces you to spend money, the stuff at the shop cost way to much, and the board space is smaller than the one advertised! What's more I keep getting the same missions, and the drop rate for the mysterious letter is way way low! I'm at level 54 and still no mysterious letter! I don't want to break my phone tapping furiously just to get it!!!

It's ok. It takes a looong time to make most of the items so energy goes out quick. Also, I have 3 orders that I have zero ability to fill. It makes no sense. I have over 6k coins but can't build anything because the only way to get tool boxes is to make teacups, soap, or some fossil. None of which I have the ability to make, so why is it even an order?? Also, for the frying pan, I get maybe 1 fish dish for every 30 desserts so it's almost impossible to build the shrimp dish.

Should have read the review before downloading. 1. Does not look like the game shown in the advertisement 2. Beginning is entertaining after so level. Say 17 or so it becomes a headache waiting all day to complete the orders . 3 . Made with the sole purpose of wasting time and earning money because you have no other options if you want to continue the game . 4 . Looks the game is unachievable to me .

I really do enjoy this game. It'd just be so much better if there was an option to add friends or join clubs, and your friends could gift you energy and you them. Because you can literally use your energy in 30 seconds. Then you have to wait forever to get more. There should be more ways than just buying them... I love this game but I can see it being uninstalled out of frustration very soon!

Pros: nice artwork, solid gameplay, addictive, lots of fun for me personally. Cons: the nagging to buy item packs, it's hard to keep the game going for more than 5 mins without watching a ton of adds to get more energy. New con. My game is glitching, I'll merge items and they stay the same item even tho the mechanics say it's the next level up example I'll merge 2 yogurts but instead of the cake I still have what looks to be a yogurt, but the game says it as a cake, disappointed.

I really love thos game. My favorite of the merge games, BUT I'm getting so frustrated getting orders and not being able to fulfill orders because the producers aren't giving me the items I need. Yes, I know it's supposed to be a challenge, but I just used 300 coins and got 2 items I needed to create an object yhsts like 9 levels up. That's not a challenge or fun. That's BS. And it's making me want to delete the app.

This is a great game. I'm totally addicted. BUT stop being stingy with the energy!! 100 bolts goes quickly. I appreciate that I can watch ads for an extra 25 but c'mon!! And the daily tasks are too many and too lengthy to complete. Find ways to reward players with more energy. I don't mind spending $1.99 for energy or a little more for bundles but you have to reward your players more often or we will find other similar games.

I want to love the game. It's super addictive and there's a lot to do. However, the cost to play it for any length of time is pretty high! I've spent the equivalent of over 800 gems for energy and all I've been trying to get is one surfboard and one statue. You only gain a max of 100 energy every 3+ hours, then it caps out without buying more or using more gems. There really isn't a reward system and I think that's what's lacking. I've already spent $30 to play, and that's a huge money grab.

Simpler than most merge games. The thing I like most about it is that there are very few ads, and the ones they do show you are optional (to pop some bubbles). I wish they would give one free energy chest per day in the shop and also I wish they would offer some amount of ingredients at the cost of coins. Currently they charge gems for them and gems are not that easy to accumulate. Otherwise, entertaining game and I love the building stories.

Would be a fun game, but hard to get matches after about level 15. You have to wait about 3 & a half hours for the energy to refill, and that is spent in less than 2 minutes making matches after that level. Purchase items aren't worth it due to how fast the energy is spent & how slow it's regenerated. You will spend too much money. It's not worth the time to play for free, and it's a waste of money if you purchase the "offers".

The game is fun at first, and even the events/special daily tasks seem feasible until you get to a certain point and then they're just trying to get your money. I have spent way more money than I care to admit trying to beat certain levels but at some point, the daily specials stopped having good value. Also, the requests get impossible when you include producers that need other items to for it to MAYBE generate what's being asked. This game is frustrating to play if past level 15, if that.

All it does now is crash or lag and then crash. It won't even open at all if you're not on wifi. I've even went to different locations under different wifi and nothing works. Uninstalling. Also it sucks that you only get 100 energy when it takes nearly double or triple that too fill orders. And you always get the same cards over and over again in the card packs and very rarely get the ones needed to complete the set without having to make a purchase. Terrible game now and not worth the energy.

It's one of the more enjoyable merge games, with simpler mechanics, and it's much easier and more satisfying to make progress. Really fun. I've ended up setting 3h timers to come back with full energy. Would really like some other Energy recharge option, or possibly a slightly higher chance of chests/gems, I've had chests in my inventory since I started building 4~5 and never gotten another chest to merge it with.

It was awesome but as you progress, it's almost impossible to do the Daily Challenges, let alone finish the Albums without spending an ungodly amount of diamonds to get more energy or buy items. And with the new update that gives you orders for producers that you never intended to activate, it's even more frustrating. Seems like they just want to force you to spend real money on it to be successful. I already wanted to stop when they redesigned the game, but gave it another chance, now I'm done.

I like the game, but with all of the changes, it's too difficult trying to complete orders. I can spend 200 energies and still not complete one order. Seems like the game is rigged to not produce what you need. For example, with the produce, I can go through 40+ energy before getting a mushroom. So, it takes days to complete an order. I understand that the game should get more challenging as you advance, but I'm seriously contemplating just deleting it because I refuse to pay to advance.

I have been playing for a few months, paying for diamonds sometimes. The game was fun and relaxing. I'm rating it one star, because it's becoming worse and worse. First, the cards seem to never be available, no matter how many packs you open. It's frustrating to play more than an hour and spend so much energy to receive no rewards. Secondly, now the game is malfunctioning and asking for unlocked items, trying to force me to play with producers that I don't like. It has become very tiresome.

At first I would have rated this app five stars all the way. However what you did with the pottery was not just meant to challenge. Other producers take one tap to produce an item. This one takes five. Then on top of that the item may or may not be useful. And ON TOP OF THAT it takes five more taps to remove the unuseful item from the limited playing space. I know a cash grab when I see it. It almost feels fraudulent. I bought several packs from you. Never again.

It's cute and fun but before moving to a new items the old ones must be purchased, so there will not be left overs, if not there will not be value for the energy wasted. Those who purchases the items and give gifts, should include dimons, I wanted to uninstall the app, but to wait and see what happens, please do something about energy, because almost at level 40, the energy level or threshold should also develop or increase to 300 or 400, instead of 100, and the ads for energy should increase

3.5 stars. I love this game, I've been playing it for two years, but compared to other similar games ,its sooo difficult to level up. you would need to spend a lotttt of money to level up at the same rate as other games, even if you spend as long playing this game as you do other games. I understand the orders get more difficult as you progress, but it's very difficult to progress. aside from that,I love to wind down after work to play it. just wish loyal players weren't expected to cash up

it starts out great! but by level 30.... it takes up to 500 energy bolts to get some items and you are only allotted 100 per every 2 hours? you hafta buy anything else!!! The game is relatively entertaining but it takes WAY TOO LONG to load. Lately it won't load at all. It keeps saying connection lost but I have full signal. Addicting. Love game totally obsessed. Now to the point of uninstalling. Been playing the game a long time, on a very high level but now it cost 4 energy to play the game instead of 2. I've been playing for about 2 months. Last week when the update became available, my game will no longer load on my iPad. It's stuck on the Update Available screen. It's unbelievable, although you are receiving bad reviews instead of trying to improve you make it worse. Since the last maintenance not even the ads for extra energy we don't have. I've been playing this game for quite a long time and I am at level 80, it's getting harder and harder to play it.

Once upon a time I loved this game, till it was bought by greedy developers who made it near impossible to progress on the game without spending money. It was fun at first but it started to get really hard. It ain't free period. That charge takes too long. Only to match a few and its gone. Gonna take forever to get to a level. So you pay to play. I like these games but soon I'm gonna stop playing - I would have been a loyal player if it wasn't so expensive. Also its glitchy. I can't complete a task so I can't level up.

Fun at first, then it becomes too hard and therefore boring because you just simply cannot progress. Takes 500-600 energy just to fulfill one single order due to the rarity of the item spawn rate. The game is very nice, however, sometimes you struggle for days to finish one order. It would be helpful if there is an option to control what type of product you need to get. Finally there should be a separate inventory for the items that produce products as sometimes you end up having you board send inventory full.

They've made these changes that has made the game impossible to play, reach any milestones, finish the dailies or weekly challenges, side events, everything. I spend occasionally, no problem, but these changes have made it so 1 or 2 small purchases doesnt even bring you halfway to completing one order. You've got to keep spending otherwise you won't get the rewards you want. I'm about to give up on it.

I quite like the game, BUT the whole system with energy is so dumb. It goes out way too fast and at first you can watch an add for some energy but that has limits as well. Especially the bigger stuff you have to merge the more ridiculous it gets, you can't get a single end-level item without having to wait for recharges for 3 hours. Either make the charging faster OR purchasing them more cheap. 40 gems for 5 minutes of gameplay is just rude.

I like the game - but it's impossible to finish "daily tasks" at the higher levels without spending money -at least $18/day, they have options to spend less but it doesn't get you very far. Overall, I like this game. However, after level 10, it becomes a grind trying to merge higher level items. It's very frustrating. The spawners should drop higher level items. I don't mind putting money into a game, but I don't pay for consumables. The monetary cost is too high for small amounts of energy. If I could pay to permanently raise my energy cap or decrease the time it takes to regenerate energy, I would happily do so. It would make the game much more enjoyable.

Changing from a 4 star to a 1 star review. I used to enjoy this game quite a bit until this update. There are too many negative changes that were made. The bubbles turning into coins and smaller amounts of energy from chests are a problem for me. The reduction of ads to watch for energy is a bad change. I am less inclined to play now, which also means less inclined to spend money on this game. Not a fan of the diamond color change. Honestly, I will probably uninstall. Not fun anymore.

I've mostly enjoyed the game (level 42), and despite having to wait for timers, it gives me the opportunity to return back to the game at my leisure. I am still unable to unlock the mysterious fossil with the needed envelopes as they do not spawn for me and takes away from having 4 orders now down to 3 due to unable to complete.

Like it, but extremely difficult to complete the daily tasks with only 100 energy cap to get extra rewards. Gems are way too hard to get unless you want to buy them. This game has big pop-ups to make purchases as soon as you run out of energy. So if you are tapping away fiercely you run the risk of tapping on the purchase button when the ad pops up, which I did.

Not what was advertised. This game popped up as an ad. In the game it showed you making coffee orders for people. That's not what this game is. It's addictive, you only watch ads if you want extra rewards, and I would give it 4 stars if not for today's glitch. I enjoy the game, but we have very limited energies especially for the pottery. Aside from that, will we EVER get more space on the board?? This is my 2nd time downloading this game. It's just as awful as I remember. It's very glitchy and freezes constantly. Also, some items are impossible to make. I was enjoying this game. But as you level up, the goals are extremely unreasonable to achieve. There is absolutely NO way to complete all of the daily goals to get the top prize. This game suffers from the same problems I see in most merge games. Not enough real estate on the board, not enough energy to spawn items, and worst of all, a high demand for items with a low spawn rate. Generally frustrating to play, and the characters, dialogue, and plot didn't do much for me personally. Much better merge games exist elsewhere.

Got this game for fetch points, but it's proven itself. I love this game! The biggest problem I have with it is how much "energy" you get to be able to create items that you eventually merge. I can play through my playable moves in like 15 minutes and then I'm stuck waiting a few hours until all my stuff refreshes. Unless you want to spend money. Hate that part of it :( but the game has great content.

I really really like this game. But after playing for a few weeks, it's becoming a big lie on how long you have to play to make new points. If it takes that long to make a few cents, it takes a lot of the fun away.....going back to Just play, they have been fair and reliable for years. I have enjoyed this game thoroughly throughout the past couple of months, im now on level 27 and completely stuck unless I spend countless hours and days trying my luck at getting a mysterious fossil to hopefully get more "requests". This is a great game. However you have spend money to be able to buy more energy. It takes forever to make an item. You can only use your diamonds to purchase items from the store and not your coins. Just tossing my review out after a levels 1-19. I have played as much as possible just coming from another game to earn a reward that required me to beat level 19. As another reviewer commented, you can't possibly be okay with your players logging on for 2 minutes, then waiting 3+ hours to get energy back. Find ways to refill energy.

Very close to giving this game up. The higher you get, the more energy required to fill orders. I previously spent some $ just to keep the game going, but it is now beyond ridiculous. I used up 400 energy just to get 1 item. Recent updates changed the sets that I had previously fully completed. Looking back through my album, there are now lots of empty spaces.
