The game was alright at the start, then it got progressively more annoying the higher you get. Some items needed to fulfill orders are so rare, and not even buying gems or power etc would help bcz you just won't get the missing pieces. Case in point, at level 51, I've 3 orders out of 4 that need stitched panel, dress form, and simple dress. All these need the stitched cloth which is extremely rare!! So yeah, I'm ditching the game. It's become more frustrating than relaxing for me.

I enjoyed this game for the first couple of weeks I played it. But once you get past a certain level, the only way to complete the daily challenges is to buy! It took me 1800 energy to complete one order today! And it was for a single item. Game gives you 1 energy every 2 min w/100 max. The only way to complete orders in a single day is to buy, and the only way to complete the daily challenges is to buy a lot! Don't waste your time playing unless you plan on spending money!

I love the game, and don't mind the wait, but that clay thing is awful!!! Worst thing you could do. It takes 5 energy to create something and then you have a broken clay piece...so another 5 energy to get rid of it??? Very dissatisfied on that one. I used 100 energy and created 6 broken clay items in a row that I had to get rid of with all my energy. Please change that!

I really like this game but the 'recharging' is inconsistent and unfair. If people run out of energy they would be more inclined to spend $$ to get more but when you have to wait so long for items to recharge, then is it really worth it. I did spend money to purchase diamonds but l am now regretting my purchase. Please reconsider the need for 'recharging' as this would make it a nice, relaxing game to play and not so frustrating.

This game was fun, and there was always a task to do, so I was never bored. Perhaps there was way too much going on for my taste? I also found myself wanting to spend more actual money to continue playing at my preferred level of enjoyment. That's more of a me problem, though. Also, I felt weirded out by some character text dialogue--specifically Matt's (I believe that's his name) comments towards the relationship between Summer and Oscar. The pregnancy inquiry was unnecessary.

I think the gameplay is pretty fun but I'm not a fan if the limited energy system. Pros: Gameplay is fairly entertaining This game doesn't force you to watch ads which is nice. It's a good if you like a game where you can play in short bursts. Cons: The game only gives you 100 energy that you can use within 5-10 minutes. Then it's either pay up or watch ads. You don't get much for watching ads. An improvement I would like is to get 100 energy for watching the ads instead of 25 and not limit ads.

Fun game to play at the beginning. Easy to merge and earn what is needed. Have been playing less than 6 months. Not a lot of ads which was really nice. Like most games, never enough energy to keep playing more than about 20 minutes each time. After a while, the orders to fill are the secondary items to come out of what you are tapping to gain items to merge so extra energy is always needed. Energy can be purchased by those who have the money to spare.

The game was really fun at first. The further you go into the game the more restrictions they add to playing like the generators only being able to give around 10 items before recharging and thr characters requesting items that are so rare they are almost impossible to create. And now the pottery level where you are pretty much just wasting the little energy you have. I get making the game harder as you level up but this has become impossible and a waste of my time.

Very fun game the story is not super engaging. Or rather I should say it's a pleasant past time. Trying to make songs with the notes that the items play when merging is fun. And I kind of wish they gave you like achievements or goals with those. The energy system is atrocious. Making you have to stop playing or pay money. And even worse is the daily mission system. The minute that I thought I was able to do all of them in a day, they changed it To make it impossible without paying.

At one stage I loved this game but then As I went further into it I spent half the time having to deal with popups about sales and quests than actually playing the game! And even when I would click on it another popup would come up then another and another!!!! It became so much I got so irritated I closed the game!! I get that Developers need to make money but you don't need to shove it down our throats all the while inhibiting gameplay...

Was addictive at first. Very quickly becomes time consuming and boring. Developers obviously haven't played this game because very quickly you need to buy gems to move up. It takes 100's of energy to complete 1 task and to refill 100 energy cost 40 gems. 100 energy cant even complete 1 item. Definitely wont be seeing this game out. I get making money, but to make it impossible to continue without spending money is a put off. Im ok with spending money when the game gives back. Thumbs down!

It was fun until I leveled up and now it takes ages to complete just one order thanks to the limited amount of energy, time it takes to recharge (two minutes for one energy) and cap on energy (one hundred). I don't mind watching ads but there's a limited number of ads to watch just to get twenty-five energy a day. This game is just a money grabber.

On several things, you're supposed to be able to watch an add instead of paying for it with gems. Only 1 problem with this - more often than not, the ad will take you out of the game, thus causing the game to reload, & you lose whatever it was that you were trying to watch the ad to get! NOT good! I'm now SO fed up with this cruddy game, that I'M GONE! As soon as I post this, I'm UNINSTALLING it. Bye bye... 👎😠👎

Completely freezes my phone every time I open it. I even uninstalled and reinstalled it and the first thing it did was freeze my phone for 20 minutes. Find another merge game to play, there are plenty out there! EDIT: I have contacted tech support 3 times in the last two weeks with absolutely no response. I want to make sure potential players are warned before they waste their time downloading this game.

Fun to play, at first. Until orders that requires me to spend money to buy diamonds, otherwise wont ever be completed, start to show up. Not everybody can afford to spend money on games. Also, FATAL bug, how come my VERY important ITEMS, the high level items, the ones that take someone's freaking time in real life to make, just went missing and just got replaced by level 1 item like yoghurt??? This one is making it way too discouraging to play bro

I play this game more than a year. First i get until level 65 but the game lost. And u cannot help to recover. Then i start a new game from level 1 again. After 5 months i get at level 71. But the most annoying is u give the same card every time. If u dont purchase u cannot go anywhere. This is dissapointed. No more enjoy play game. They only want our money but dont want to give more.

I never write reviews, also I never liked merging games, but this game is really unique. FANTASTIC art, nice details (stickers, group chat..) but it can easily go from interesting to boring. Progressing seems impossible, there's never enough energy and it's so easy to waste it on the small items so you never (or hardly ever) do tasks. Huge respect for the team, but hope yall can do something about the lack of energy and gems since I'm one of many people that can't invest actual money into games

It's kind of fun for a while... but once you hit level 40 or so, the game starts expecting you to use gems daily to get more energy, and also to build items that take 1000+ energy to build, which takes over two hours to recharge. The events are impossible to complete in the time allotted unless you spend all your time playing the game every free second. I give up.

It was fun at first, but as you progress it becomes much harder to advance. The main goal of the game seems to be frustrating the player into making in game purchases. The dialogue and storytelling when unlocking parts of the island was cute at first, but not worth checking in with the game every 3 hours to continue to advance. The daily quests began to seem pointless when I realized that no matter how diligently I played, I would never achieve them without paying real money.

Love this game except every time I run out of energy, which is often, I get 3-4 pop-up offers (for the game, not 3rd party ads) one after another, which are incredibly annoying. They're the same offers that I can click on at the side of the board so it's pointless to have them all pop up like that. Edit: there are now 8-10 pop-ups every time I open the game. There are way too many events and offers going on at once, it's frustrating when I'm just trying to play the game.

I really like this game, however, there needs to be a 'cheat sheet' somewhere to know what needs to merge for the other items. For example: When you get to the end of the paper string (diary), you need to merge the pen (a different string of items) to get to the book string of items. I finally had to Google it to find out. You really should include this in the chest or somewhere so we don't delete (throw away) items that are at max but you don't know what to do with them.

This game was fun like the first 10 levels but im at 30 and I can't play for more than 60 seconds because you run out of energy so fast you can't complete anything. there's like 6 pop ups every time you get on. I spent 24 gems to get an energy chest and I didn't get it, it gave me a tool box even though I used gems to get a energy box. It's very difficult to save up gems and they just want you to spend money. saving all those for no reason

I am a player that doesn't mind spending a few dollars each month for a better experience and the ability to move forward in the game without waiting as long. But seriously? The way these generators work, it's possible to spend 300-500 energy without completing a single order. The play is very uneven. I zoomed through some levels, stayed stuck on others. It's a fun game, but there are similar or better games that aren't so lopsided with rewards and won't act like a Vegas slot machine.

the game itself is very enjoyable but the higher your level the longer it takes to complete orders. it requires way more energy which the amount of doesn't increase with levels. you get a 100 energy to start, can watch 4 adds for an additional 25 energy per ad(which by the way,doesn't really get you anywhere) then you have to wait about 3 hours for your energy to recharge. and then there are way to many extra things going on at the same time. you can only finish them if you can spend money.

So tired of games that don't actually let you play them. For a minute I thought this one was different, when I first downloaded it I was able to get a good hour of play in. But now at level 19, you get to play for 5 minutes if you're lucky, and then you either run out of energy and/or all the equipment you need to make things to craft needs to "recharge" for hours. Can't be bothered with this, deleting.

There is an update to store max level produces separately from the existing inventory box. However, my producers are not going there and I can't do it myself. There should also be more ways to earn energy like watching ads. Right now I think you can only do this 4 times a day. Otherwise, I enjoy the game because it's simple. The Amazon event was fun. This Saint Patrick day one is ok.

I loved this game but I'm sad to say it's progressively getting worse. I've seen over the last couple of days they've made changes that give you less rewards, cheaper chests, instead of getting more energy you just get more coins. This is on top of the problems it had before, like ads not playing to get bubble items and needing to pay more and more gems for storage (necessary to continue playing the game). I'm on level 143 so I've clearly dealt with that, but why are you making the game worse?

Something in the game changed overnight. They removed some of the game play, I don't understand why. The pop-ups every time you open the game are so annoying. When you run out of energy you always get 3 different pop-ups trying to get you to spend your money. 1 I get, but why 3? It also regularly runs into an issue and has to reload itself and some of the stuff you've completed has to be redone.

It was fun at first, it's very stressful if you don't pay with real money you can't progress on the game. I never complete daily and weekly goals. It's very addictive to the point of not having sleep just wait for the energy to recharge, despite of the effort and watching the ads, following them on social media etc, doing everything to get extra energy, I found out it's still impossible. I'm so depressed. I'm done with this game.

HIGHLY DO NOT RECCOMEND... YOU WILL REGRET WASTING YOUR TIME!! To slow. Eventually you might end up being able to do 1 order a day. The prize boxes and 30 minute producer unlock prize is basically useless. Im on it a few times a day for less than 5 minute sessions to use my energy and get closer to making an order. Such a slow and boring game. theres not even a friends list so you can compete

The game is a fun passive type of game but there are wayyyyyy too many events and pop-ups. Sometimes I'll open the app and deal with 9 things I have to close one after the other and it gets really really frustrating. Some of them you have no choice whether you want to join or not. please enable an option to opt out of events or to just manually click on them. I'm like this close to deleting the app

In the beginning it was fun, but once you're past level 20, it's just a waiting game. Before I could play for hours straight but now I play once a day/ week. I'm starting to forget this game exist on my phone. Everything takes long to refresh. And after it refreshes, it depletes in an instant. Even if I spend cash to buy diamonds, the refresh rate is ridiculous. It needs better game balancing. Get your UX to reassess and improve on retention vs transactions.

I really like the game but it's impossible to complete the missions without paying for energy or diamonds. Currently, it is possible to watch only 4 ads in exchange for energy, and I suggest making it unlimited. Let people watch as many ads as they want, or as they need energy to complete a mission. It's very frustrating to run out of energy when tasks have a limited amount of time. It's annoying to play for 5 min, then having to wait 3h30 to refill the energy and play again.

started playing recently after constantly seeing ads for it. it is fun and addictive, but would like to see options to further play and obtain items/goals without having to spend money. I have purchased several times, and it seems like the only way to make notable, and quicker, progress in the game. perhaps earning energy every one minute instead of two and capping at 200 could work. the 100 energy cap is just not enough.

This seems like a fun game. It's pretty much all merging with a little story to it. My biggest complaint (which cost this rating 2 stars) though is how energy refills increase its cost (starts at 10 gems and currently asking me for 40 now). The amount of energy doesn't increase with it; no matter how much you spend, it's always just 100, which will only cause you to be forced to buy gems; very predatory move there. Sorry, but I'd rather uninstall than resort to that. Moto G Stylus 2023.

Played this game for months and even spent money on in app purchases because I liked it so much. But now it hasn't opened for at least 3 days. I installed the latest update this morning and still can't get past "loading cloud data...". Not happy. Followed directions from support and lost about 50 or so levels. Now hasn't even opened for about a week. I'm done.

Updating my review but unfortunately can't give any more stars. This game is just not as fun anymore. The orders are so repetitive, it's the same stuff over and over again and take forever to fill them. Can take days for me to fill one order. The events are fun but not enough time to get past the halfway mark and I try to play as much as I can as soon as energy is refilled. This game is more frustrating than fun after all the updates of downgrades I should say.

I am absolutely addicted to this game but have one issue. I'm currently at level 60 and have a task including a level four bar food. Before this task I had no issue with getting bar food, in fact I had too many of the items, and fruit was supposed to be the rare one. Since this task popped up, though, I have spent AT LEAST 600 energy on the bar menu to absolutely no avail. Not even one level 1 tomato. It's really odd and feels like it's consciously rigged against me.

I DL'd Travel Town based on an ad, and it was fun for a few days to destress. But now I'm level 19 and run out of energy in less than 5 mins and can't get more without spending gems I don't have, so I found a similar game in the app store related to cooking. The new game lets me buy energy with ads, gives energy after completing tasks and builds, and keeps me on the app for hours playing vs minutes per day. I really have to wonder about the decision making process behind this app...

I agree with many reviews here when they mention about rare items in the orders. Before you can get to it, you run out of energy. And it's monotonous merging over and over again. It wouldn't be so bad if we could use coins, which I have a lot of, to buy energy. I don't have enough gems in the game to buy energy, and I'm not going to be spending money in the app. If you change it so that energy could be bought with game coins, I'll rate this game better.

Great game, has no ad issues, and is well thought out. It looks like devs made an effort in the game and the art (though it is simple). And not those lame puzzle games either. Easy to progress and understand, perfect for beginner gamers and young children. Unlike most games nowadays, it is possible to enjoy this game without wasting real money if resources are spent wisely. This game is not meant to be played for long sessions, so play it like that.

items in your que will randomly be taken away if they sit too long. a lot of hard work goes into saving up these items for game progression. when asking for technical support, moderators will simply blame it on YOU exploiting the game somehow selling and undoing the selling of items. UPDATE. they absolutely did not help. Just doubled down on blaming me. there is no possible way I lost items playing the way I have been playing. they are petty and punish you for utilizing what's available to you.

I'm playing for almost and year and the game had two major updates in that time. Or should say downgrades. Instead of make the gameplay better, it made it worse. And it happaned mid game, no warning, no heads-up, not even a log of what's change, you have to go on Reddit to be sure the updates weren't a bug (that's how bad they were). I was closed to completing an album, now I know I won't be able to do it. I also will not complete the Weekly challenge, all because of this update.

Regarding developer response: I understand the point of pop-ups and have no problem with that. The problem is having to click through 6, 7, 10 pop-ups each time I open the game. You could design a single pop-up with tabs for each promo or deal. Consolidate. Let us decide if we want to wade through it all and what we want to participate in. The issue isn't the promos or the deals. It's your delivery that sucks.

Great game. My only wish is that you'd get more energy if you spend gems. Gems don't come around often enough for you to be spending half of them for only 100 energy, which lasts about 5 minutes of game play. If you spend gems, you should get more than the limit so you feel it's worth the cost. This is still not a huge factor in quality, just a suggestion to make it even better...

I'm only giving 3 stars because of the reasons listed below. $$ If you want to advance quickly without paying $, this is NOT the game for you. I really enjoy this game (never thought I'd play a merge game), BUT if you want to play longer than a few minutes at a time, you'll need to fork out $$$. (I won't spend another dime - looking for another game!!) Plus, there are game "producers" that require using multiple energy (ABSOLUTE WORST part of the game). Make changes, and I'll play again.

I've been playing for a good min on this game for at least 2 years. Recently the past few months it's been crashing. Like I start the game it loads, then all the pop ups before you can play then maybe a few merges. it freezes, turns the screen black and kicks me off. I tried on wifi, my phone data. nothing stops it from crashing like that. I've put a lot of money and time into this game. I'd like to keep playing but until this gets fixed I won't be able to continue to play, because I can't.

Game is very enjoyable. But why are we only allowed to send 2 cards a day. Maybe if it was up to 5 or 10, it would help a lot. So many player are connecting to help each other, but 2 seems very stingy. New add to review. Pushing players to spend cash is fine, but not everyone has cash to spend. Energy takes forever to get more. Sometimes it takes days to do one order. Even with all the facebook groups to exchange cards, it still is un uphill battle to complete sets. I take away 1 star

I started playing last week. The game began beautifully enough , then I noticed you couldn't progress without spending money. It hyped my anxiety level on the 5th day or so as I desperately tried to finish my daily tasks and get the ultimate reward. But I didn't make it. I made a single purchase at a point and noticed it didn't help me progress further. So I get it. The game is designed to make you spend money daily. And spend a lot of time online. Not for me. Game goes into my freezer.

At first the game seemed interesting as I love the sea and I was hoping I'd be able to merge ALIVE marine animals. It was very disappointing that all of the characters claiming to be activists seem to eat them, but at least the first foods with corpses weren't TOO graphic. Then they added "seafood" (animals are not food...) and that's when I just could not stand playing anymore. I could clearly see dead animals (mostly shrimps) laying on the plates.

This game is so cute. I've been playing for a few weeks and it's really addictive! I really like the interface and the art style - it's much cuter than other merge games I've seen and I find the animations very pleasing, the characters and the town design are also prettier than other games. The only problem I have is that the difficulty escalates way too much - it gets so much more expensive to improve your town and it really slows down progress (in an obvious attempt to get you to spend money)

Super addictive game, but real $$$ are really needed to get anywhere after a while. Shame it's so expensive and the power given each day gets used up in about 2 mins. I've spent too much money on it now and figured I could purchase a whole different game and not have to keep pumping in the cash - they must be making bank! Fun while it lasted, but I've deleted the app now, just too expensive.

it was fun for awhile. I have been playing for about 2 years and it is getting too hard to do the tasks. you get too many tasks for top teir items and nit enough energy unless you pay too much money. some of the things you use to fill tasks get put in storage but you still get orders for but you don't have room for them. I have had 3 orders that after 5 months won't go away. It is so boring now that I am ready to delete. don't waste you time as it keeps going

GOAT Support team. Seriously. Shoot them an email about a bug or an issue, and you could have your issue sorted very quickly. They are the icing on the cake to a game I find pretty unique in the merge game world. It's not all looks and no mechanics. There have been moments where I felt encouraged to by a pack, not because it's forced on me (it's not), or pay to win, but because it adds to my experience. Bugs will always exist, but the people (dev team and players alike) is what makes it sing.

Game is good in theory. But they're just money hungry. If you don't have $50 a day to spend you can't complete any daily tasks or monthly tasks for that matter. It takes days to a week to complete 1 order ots super frustrating and disappointing. It could be super fun and I wouldn't even mind spending $ from time to time but the more u spend the more they ask for. It's terrible. There are tons of other merge games that aren't money gauging.

Started off great but the last update took all the fun away. Auto producers aren't producing, auto orders aren't showing up. Been playing for over a year, even spent real money to play it. u Uninstalling it, it's not fun anymore. Had orders lined up with items ready to go, now they aren't orders anymore. Clearly you only want players who will pay to play even though there are a ridiculous number of ads.

I like this game .. my only observation) complaint would be how much you have to use energy to get items from a production station that has the same items that have nothing to do with what you need. like fruit and drinks in the menu board... or tiles and dishes ... feathers and pools etc... run out of energy trying to get the items needed....makes it much less fun than other games 😔 at times. otherwise I like it 😁

I like the game for the most part. It is, however, extremely frustrating because of the excessive number of items from different merge groups that come from the same producer & the extremely excessive amount of energy bars needed to get 1 item of a challenge. Energy and diamonds are very expensive and deplete quickly. The game is definitely designed to separate you from your money. I understand that the creators of the game want to make money, but I think they could do better by the customers.

Hope this gets better, I have played other games were you use energy. I want to see how far you can go without spending money. So far I've stalled a few times and I've just started. Need money to continue before you even get engrossed or excited about the game. You only get a couple of minutes play time before your stalled again. Just learning how to get more coins which is a plus. I wish the dialogue with the characters told you more about what you should do for the game. But things are moving.

This is actually a fun game, although I've only been playing for a couple of months. This past few weeks though, there will be times that the game won't launch, it would just end up loading to 28% and gets stuck there. I tried checking for an update, I thought maybe my game is outdated, but nah.. mine's still up to date. There really must be something with the game's system that needs fixing. HELP 🥺

Once you get a decent way into the game, you get quests that can only be completed by paying gems. I have reached a point where all the quests I have are that way, so I am stuck. The game says it is possible to acquire the items normally, but through literally hundreds of attempts with nothing, either the drop rate is way too low, or it is impossible.

2* and I'll tell you why: I need to go to 6-10 pop-ups before getting to the actual game. You are forced to play challenges or competitions although not to want to take part. Certain items are produced so sparsely that you can't fullfil orders in time, except if you are willing to spend a lot of money. I understand developers need to get paid; however, this is a rip-off. It's not possible to turn off sounds. Playing and listening to music is not possible.

I downloaded this game to get credits in a different app but now I just play this game for fun because it's pretty entertaining. However, I do have one complaint. I wish that idle energy storage didn't stop at 100. It's honestly a little frustrating when I'm trying to do something but I don't have the gems or the irl money to get more energy. I feel like a more reasonable idle energy limit is 300.

I never write reviews but I'm so frustrated. I'm on level 58 and it's so fun to play except that it is rigged to make you spend a fortune. The items drain energy so quickly that you end up having to use energy to keep playing or wait for them to recharge, which takes ages. They have a few like the pottery wheel and fishnet that take 5 taps to produce an item, and then have to recharge. I could go on but there's not enough room. It's the worst cash cow app I've ever played and I'm deleting it.

A fairly simple game where you match objects to one another to make new objects. For some reason the game has "energy" and when you run out you can't play anymore until you wait for it to recharge or pay money to charge it. Being literally unable to play a game without waiting to recharge energy wrecked it for me. Why wouldn't I just play another version of the same game that doesn't force me to wait?

Omg the constant CONSTANT waiting. The higher you go, the more waiting you do. It would make sense if as you increased levels, you got to have more energy, instead, the producers need more energy but you don't get to have more unless you buy it. Then the producers need to recharge (which has to be the most senseless part of the game). There's an inventory for max producers but you can only put the initial 2 in. First 15 levels are fun, but after that, it doesn't make sense to keep going.

This game is meticulously crafted to try and take as much as your money as possible. I am 100% convinced that this game cheats. Every time you are going for a specific order all of a sudden less of that particular item's prerequisites drop a lot less. Some times while merging items a duplicate of the item you just made will appear in a bubble that can be popped with ads or diamonds. Don't bother clicking the ad option because half the time the ad will run and the game will crash.

I'm on level 20 and it's unreasonable the amount of items you have to go through to complete orders. Burning through energy super fast because of the unnecessary items I have to click through. Exhausting really. One example, silverware could be in it's own pop-up section instead of with the food because it's wasting an incredible amount of energy & space weeding through it. Dessert, salad, main dishes from same pot is WAY too much to get through for one order. Otherwise I love the game.

It would get 5 stars if I could play as long as I want to. I don't mind waiting for things to recharge, but I quit your game and go play a different game each time I run out of energy. This is my favorite time waster, but I'm playing something else because I don't have energy. Pretty stupid design if you ask me. At a minimum, max energy should be higher than 100, or you could have gifts that include the equivalent of 30 minutes unlimited lives (30 minutes unlimited energy).

Good app, but honestly I'm not spending money on it anymore. After you reach higher levels it's basically pay to play, otherwise progress is really slow. Unless I'm shelling out, I can only play for a good five minutes before I'm out of energy and have to wait hours again for it to replenish. Last time I spent money on an $11 card pack hoping to complete the album. Didn't get a single new card and wasn't worth it at all, felt like a total waste of money. I honestly feel like I deserve a refund.

It starts out like any other merge game, but once you hit level 19 to 20 the characters start "requesting" items that you either can't make or you can, but it's not explained how. The creation items that you tap to make things are very inconsistent. Example- you get a Sauce Pan to create, desserts, fish, and/or salad. Tapping it produces plenty of dessert, a little fish, and rarely salad. I have tried for three days to get salad for one character. I open the app around 6 times a day.

I love this game until the most recent update. Before the update, you'd get 4 offers of 25 free energy for watching an ad. After the update, they took it away. Before the update, you'd get 3 offers to pop a bubble for watching an ad. After the update, they took that away, too. Also, why have the option of adding friends in game if you can't trade cards or interact with them? There's no point? Guess they don't appreciate their players anymore since they took away the few freebies we could earn.

This is one of the best looking merge games I've played. The first week having it was great. You make a lot of progress pretty quickly & the game gives you lots of rewards for your progress so it got me hooked. It didn't take long until I noticed my progress plateaued. The past few days when I launch the game I run out of energy within a few minutes and I'm never able to fulfill any order now because all of the items the customers are requesting are super high leveled. Feels like a waste of time

Other than how quickly energy runs out, the pop ups when first opening the game, and progression gets slow after a point in the game and you'll have to start spending money. But otherwise it's pretty enjoyable. I get more gameplay if I collect the free energies, usually found on Facebook or you can use the Travel Card app to collect them all there. There's three or four free energy links a day, I add the last for new players interested in playing the game who might not know.

The main problem with this game is how pushy it is for people to spend money, so much so that they make the initial daily challenge ridiculous to try to get through. You could spend hundreds of dollars in the game and feel like you haven't made much progress. The energy consumption is INSANE. Also, if you're going to have a trading function, PLEASE add a way to delete people from your friends list in game itself. Lists get way to cluttered went your can't delete the people you just trade with.

great game, but after a couple days I noticed that if I had 6 energies, and clicked fast the energy would be at 0 but I would have only like 2 items. I realized is because of the master boost. I don't see the point of giving a boost for higher items but at your own cost. Wish that was different. Also, I keep getting friend requests from other travelers byt what's the purpose of this if you can't ask them for energy or anything?.

This game is really good to help clear my head a lot of times. The dialogue throughout the game is interesting to read, sometimes funny. My reasons why I'm not giving this game a five star is I feel the recharge time on what produces merge items is long and the amount of energy we are given doesn't seem like enough sometimes when trying to get the right items to fulfill the orders, like the energy is gone before you get any item that's needed to merge into what orders are asking for.

I've been an avid player a long time but the game has gotten to be a time suck and just not fun anymore. Recent updates have destroyed the game. The Challenges are unattainable without spending money and a lot of it. Even when you complete the challenges, the card packs you earn are filled with duplicates so you can't advance in the season either. It's a shame, it was a fun game but I'll be uninstalling ✌️

Once you reach a certain point in the game orders from the customers require very high level items and with only 100 energy every ~3 hours and item generation cool down, it's really impossible to move forward. You get some coins daily but those coins can only be used for upgrading buildings in the village, gems are impossible to come by freely despite a requirement to use them in the daily tasks, energy rewards for watching an ad are only 25 energy for each ad but that's only 3x a day.

Don't download unless you have a lot of time. It's very addictive! Ads are well spaced. Every now and then an ad will not load right but when you exit the game and go back in you are right where you left off. All in all it's one of my favorite games. Refreshing to get a good one after so many fakes and duds. Challenging yet simple. After level 35 be ready for major $ and mega hours to complete a level. Took too long and I lost interest trying to move levels. Honestly guys you had IT for a while.

Can't play much, you run out of energy too fast considering how many objects you have to make; so kind of a bummer... It's actually kinda fun but that ruins it and it seems different from all the other games that are so similar to each other and get boring... It would be good if there were ways to earn more energy like side puzzles to earn energy and watch ads.... I can only play for like 5 min and then out of energy... I dont spend money on games...

It was super fun for awhile but after having it for a week or so the game stopped working. Everytime I try to play it freezes. At first I thought it was just when I would click stuff, but nope. Even if I never touch anything on the screen everything freezes. The whole game. It got worse and worse after each new update that has come out since. I was hoping the updates would fix the problem, also nope! It's completely unplayable. I can't merge items, get items, or even just interact with the game.

I started playing this game through a rewarded game ap, to receive free gift cards. I played but initially didn't like it, but it got better. I started to enjoy completing the collections. It just ruined that for me. If you don't know the game; this means the game shifted & my personal reward for the game is gone. Eg; Reach the top peak, they reward u & they move the mountain & tell u do it again. beyond aggravated I play the 'rewarded play' games that I enjoy. Not for the reward. not smart

It takes too much time to refill energy yet consume energy for everything . So to make some item hafta wait more than 2 days sometimes . It feels bored then. Its hard to make building items and therefore renovations are going too much slowly. If energy can be refilled within 25 seconds rather than 2 minutes game would be interesting . Then energy will refill within 42 minutes at least . (Still it is somewhat longer period ut rather than 3 and half hour it is nice). Money consuming app.👎

I've played many merge games, this one is the most controlling by far. It even tells you to 'buy' things with the happiness you've gathered, before you can gather more happiness. They didn't want to use 'money', but kept the exact same concept, just called it happiness and made it smileys. Even in the beginning it feels like a slow game where you need to merge way too often to get somewhere, so it gets repetitive really fast. Not my cup of tea, but I see others enjoy it, so maybe I'm wrong XD

This was my favorite game but recent updates have really lowered my enjoyment. Things feel locked behind a pay wall and energy isn't given out seemingly at all now, whereas you could gather extra energy over time in the past. It's a shame, because I was giving money to this game because I loved it. I won't be giving it anymore now that it's going the same route as all the similar games. A shame that such a diamond in the merge game industry is becoming nothing more than a lackluster money grab.

It's a fun game on the surface, but is the least giving when it comes to energy of any merge game I've played. Daily tasks are borderline extremely difficult if you're not setting timers for when your energy recharges or something. I'm lucky to complete one big item in a full day. It's an issue many merge games have and a few things have been added to combat that grind, but not nearly enough. It was fun for a few weeks or so.

Love the game but I struggle so much trying to get items or to progress further. It takes 5 minutes to depelete all the 100 energy but it's take 2 minutes for only 1 energy. This makes me lose interest in the game as I only play for 5 minutes unless I buy diamonds for energy. Not everyone has money to splurge on a game that would get boring after 10 minutes. Even if I accumulate more than 100 energy it takes a long time to get an item, I could get multiples of an item that I don't need

The game is pretty cool. But when your level increases, the material that comes again and again, it wastes a lot of energy, merging them again and again, then repeating on repeat is a waste of time, if one or two items are already mixed in the next level, then it is easy. By the time you reach there, the energy gets completely exhausted, either watch the advertisement for energy or wait for a long time,Make the game easy. Not such a waste of time.There is a lot of coin wastage in every new level

I love playing this game, but there are 2 downfalls that I wish would be adjusted. First, it would be nice to increase the daily trade amount for cards. It is connected to a group with hundreds of thousands of people if you so choose to interact with others. So I feel like a max of 2 is too little. Maybe a max of 5? Lastly, extra gold cards should be available to trade to others or sell for gems. There is no reason the game should keep stacking up on a card you can't give away or sell. Thanks!

False advertising! Seriously, why is ad showing something completely different than the actual game??? I installed it expecting to solve the problems of ruined house: fixing windows, leaking roof, broken fireplace etc. as advertised, but all this is is just stacking similar items on a board. Not even resembling the ad. Uninstalling it after I post this review.

Edit: While the developers did graciously add in new storage spaces to hide obsolete item generators, now their daily tasks are far too unreasonable. Now you have to fill 6, 8, 10, 20 orders in 24 hours just to get a mediocre bonus. The only way you could do that is by paying cash to get more diamonds to buy more energy at an exponential rate. I used to love this game, and I played it daily for those bonuses. But now they're impossible, and it just seems like a cash-grab for the game makers. ☹️

I have played and loved this game for many months. I spent far more time playing than I should have (close to 40 hours in a week, according to my phone), many times a day. It did some positive things for me (I became able to wake early). The update this week has broken my addiction to the game and managed to save me money I shouldn't spend. After they made the changes that they did, I continued for one more day, realized what had made it challenging, yet fun for me was gone, so I left.

I like the game, but as progression happens it makes it really difficult to keep playing without paying... I play another similar game and instead of just coins for items popping, it gives many chances for those to turn into energy. High level bubbles usually turn into 1-2 energy or gems, this makes it easier to accumulate a full energy meter or buy more. Also, other similar games give a lot more coin rewards. Later in the game it's harder to do anything money related.

Getting ridiculous! I completely fell in love with Travel Town when I first started playing about 6 months ago. Now, it's just stressful and frustrating with the constant high-level items that need so much energy. I don't mind paying for extra energy and used to but am not anymore because it is so frustrating. All of a sudden it takes 20,000 coins for a building upgrade? You just stop advancing. Loved the special games but same with those. Just not really fun anymore.

Honestly, the game had me hooked and it's very interesting. Please can you reduce the high coins that you take for one to purchase a building? To pass a level is very difficult because the adds up are slow. Please make the game a little easier so that one won't get frustrated playing it. The stickers should be made easier to get so as to earn the grand price. THANK YOU!!!!

I like this game very much. I would give it 5 stars if the game would let you play for more than 5 minutes. You run out of energy too fast & unless you spend money (which yes I know is how developers make their $) , all the time. Still though, the energy rate is ridiculous . No way to earn energy except a few x's to watch a few videos then 🤷🏻‍♀️. You get to add friends for what reasons? Can't ask for energy; mini games are fun but don't last long either. A day or so, hardly any time at all

I have been playing for over a year now. Loved the game. Would have recommended to anyone, really. But my God, the last few updates have sucked. They try to squeeze money out of you. There isn't enough energy, gems, or coins to advance far in the game without playing strategically. Any strategy that players come up with to play better, the developers quickly kill. Recently, they've started forcing game orders from all item producers. It's like they're trying to discourage people from playing

I got hooked on this game and really enjoyed playing it, but recently it became impossible to finish a level. You need way more tools to complete a task, and it takes many many more orders to get the tools. Not only that, the orders became much harder to complete. I'm ready to give up on the game. UPDATE, okay, now got resolved, and I am happy again.

The game is fun and slightly addictive. However, as stated in many of the reviews, once you continue to play it gets harder to fulfill orders. I'm only at level 26 and it's becoming increasingly impossible to get the items I need. I agree that the goal is to get us to spend money, but the consumer loyalty should also be considered. I'll give it a little longer but might delete the app soon.

Game is great. However, when you reach higher levels, it is much more difficult to get the items needed. So much so that sometimes, it takes me a few days to complete one order because of 1) merging too many items to get the one needed, 2) board is overcrowded with other 'needed' items, and 3) limited energy.

Starts off very strong but quickly turns to garbage. There should be ways to get energy, besides leveling up, otherwise it's just gonna bottleneck. Waiting hours to get energy for a few minutes of gameplay? Who thought that was a good idea?? Such a shame, since the game looks and plays pretty well. Another potentially great game ruined by greedy devs.

I've been playing for a while, been having fun with it for the most part, how ever a recent update/change has added extra items in the middle of a merge chain. This has now caused issues with progressing and made it so hitting temporary goals are either nearly impossible or require paid transactions to complete within the time frame. It is one thing to add another link to the merge chain at the end but to add it in the middle just to make it take extra energy before getting a dispenser item?

Was a fun game until you hit around level 20. Then it basically becomes a pay to play game. You can play without paying, but its pointless. Takes me 3 days to unlock 1 goal at this point because you can only produce 50 items every 200 minutes (3.5 hours). They need to either make more ad-to-play options or increase the energy reproduction.

This game is frustrating and feels designed to push players into spending money. Orders repeat endlessly, requiring massive energy, yet rewards are minimal. Producers generate unnecessary items, slowing progress, and toolboxes are too scarce for needed upgrades. Instead of being fun and relaxing, it’s just exhausting. I’ve uninstalled it—definitely not recommended!

This is clearly pay to play game, where they give you 100 energy, which you spent in 25 clicks which is not enough to solve anything. They ask you to pay in order to continue to play. Advertisement are becoming unbearable. The game is about to be uninstalled. Below this review is a generic review by the developer team. This is how they take it into consideration.

It started off as a fun game but as you progress through the levels you need a lot more energy to merge items. Your energy runs out quickly when merging high level items. If they increased the energy level while you gain gained higher levels it would keep me wanting to play the game. I've decided to delete this game at level 12, they've made it too hard to continue the progress

3hrs for full charge and then just 3min to spend them. Just 3 ads for extra charges. 3 days to complete bigger orders on reaching higher levels. Feels it is brainless to create this kind of concept. And to complete the daily tasks, you have to open and play this game for many times which is maddening. Now the game is struck at 30% and its been half day it's been like this.

Totally fine for the first bit, where they want you to have fun. But there are no free to play options once you get past the "free energy" stage. I'm fine watching ads until I get tired of it, but this game gives you two ads to watch for energy, TOTAL, then if you want to keep playing you literally have to purchase gems with real money. Don't waste your time

Great game. If you dont have money to spend though, don't bother. They do give you free energy, but as the levels increase, what they give you does not, yet it takes more to play. And it caps at 100. So 1 energy every 2 mins, after that, it stops increasing. And if you buy energy, so you have over 100, it doesn't let you earn any. I should still get free energy every 2 minutes. ESPECIALLY, if I'm spending $. 5 stars when energy issues change to reflect what most players also complain about.

I really like this game. It's tied up there with another one for my favorite merge game. I don't find getting the items is that difficult; you just have to keep at it. I do agree that the energy does feel limited though. But the amount of time it takes to refill is shorter than a lot of other merge games, so that's cool. Overall I love it. I really like the events too.

This game gets old very fast. After level 15-25 you start to lose traction and patience. It take 3 1/2 hrs to refill to 100 energy after using them within less than two mins. The light bulb and cash register 15 min to 20 min wait. The regular generators no more than 5 minutes. Impossible to get through without paying money. But DON'T do it. When I remember to play, I play then find something else to do. It's a pass time for a bus ride or standing in line. 3 days go by before I remember to play.

The art assets are cute, but the game play can be infuriating. It takes too long to fulfill orders, the pottery wheel and fishing nets are the worst. I feel like this game would have been better if a generator item would produce only one type of item instead of several. When you need the ones that show up less often to make a rare item for an order, it shouldn't take several days.

Great game overall, unfortunately no way to progress without spending huge amounts of money. Played for less than 10min and have to buy or wait aaaaggggeeesss for one unit of energy, which only produces one stone or the like. Unfortunately, with so many free and low cost games on the market, this just isn't worth it for me. Great effort though!

I've been playing this game for more than year and have seen how it has progressed from good to bad and to worst very recently. The energy you get finishes in less than a min. Certain producers that give more than 1 type of item are wired in a way to produce less of what you need to complete present orders (like literally the developers just don't want you to complete orders and pay real cash for energy and gems 😮‍💨🤯). It was a fun relaxing game at start but now I've come to hate it! 😤

Pretty fun freemium game. It has the standard formula, make things happen, which costs energy, run out of energy, wait for energy to refill, repeat. You can pay to top up your energy. I'm sure the higher will take FOREVER to get done. The game plays well and looks good. It's easy to play and get into the meat of it. Minus 2 stars for not having any music. No music in a time-killer game is a huge quality issue. Games like this always have good music.

I enjoyed playing this game for a little bit, but unfortunately it's another game that you have to spend money on to get anywhere.Your board fills up pretty darn fast while you're trying to make certain items... Which takes forever. There is no option to watch ads to earn purple gems which sucks..you have to buy them..my board has been full for days and I'm not spending more money...I can't play the game at all anymore cuz my board is full and my inventory slots are full also ...Deleting game.

I don't know what has happened to this game. If you close out of the app, you could come back to some of your items that could disappear, your energy disappears, or is not auto-loading on time, energy maxes out at 100 even after 8+ hours. People are spending their real money on this game are not getting the same advancement/features. The ads situation also does not make sense, why only allow +/- 5 ads a day for VERY little energy re-up? This game needs more incentive to keep engaged.

Don't be addicted to this game. It's designed to take your money. otherwise, you'll be stuck and won't be able to finish daily tasks. It was good at first, but then then the developer became greedy. In order to move forward you need to deposit tons a lot of money. Even in completing an album, at first you could complete them by just finishing daily tasks but later on nope they start giving you repetitive cards. And the only way you could complete the set is the use of joker cards.

I enjoyed the game in the beginning, but now that I'm at Level 26, it takes days to complete the orders you need to build. You use all your energy in minutes and between the recharging and the 2 minutes to get one charge you are mostly waiting to play again. I can't afford to buy energy just to be able to play, so I guess that means it's time to unistall.

I liked the orders but there are too many items for such a small board to play on. There are not enough spaces to organize the difference sets. I play on a "3D merge" app & it gives so much more space to group things together. If you like chaos on your screen, it's alright. And for the last few updates I have had to un/reinstall afterward because it wouldn't load.

It starts out as a really great game to get you hooked. You get a lot of energy in the beginning to keep you playing. Once I unlocked the pottery, that's what ruined it for me. It takes 6 energy points to produce anything and sometimes it throws broken tile or bad clay that you have to use 4 additional energy points to clear them, just to get 1 coin. Energy goes fast the further into the game you get and there's no way to get more unless you spend real money. I'm so disappointed.

I've actually spent a ton of money on this game, like $50 a month for awhile. But I won't be spending any more because I joined the Facebook group and I see avid players getting the shaft with your trading scam - players keep track of people who can't be trusted and the list is never-ending. I'll continue to play by myself and get nowhere because I've spent the money to get where I am. But shame on you for creating another unsafe gaming space online.

I've been playing this game for about a year now. If u don't pay, u will not get anywhere. Now, if you do pay, it will prevent you from getting awards. For example, under the daily tasks, there's a progress number line which gives you awards w every goal met. The goal is 2800..I completed all tasks and it only reached 2795...meaning that tomorrow I need to start all over w the false pretense of getting the 400 diamonds. I will be deleting this game.

I have been playing for awhile now!. The game was extreamly fun at first. Now there is too much going on. You not only have to spend money in order to move ahead but it now takes days sometimes weeks to finish one merge. I among many others in game have tried to get our concerns heard but they just do not listen... .sadly my review is 1 and will stay as such until the game improves and things are better.

Too easy to accidentally "purchase" an item in the game-not a real $ purchase, but rather one using "diamonds." The developers need to add a confirmation button or something. Update: they have significantly cut back rewards for in-game items, making it near impossible to achieve daily goals w/o spending $. Lots of players on reddit talking about this. I'll be joining those using up my gems and quitting the game. Not fun anymore.

I like the game , the only thing that makes me mad is with the event with cards you can only send 2 cards per day, I think it should be 2 cards per friend the limit. Another great idea would be if we can trade cards in the game , on Facebook it can be tricky. Other than that it is a great game , i would have give 5 stars if the thing with the limit would be different .

Starts like any merge game. After Level 35 onwards, it is designed to encourage spending. Certain tiles cannot be traded for Happiness and they block your playboard. Thus spending Gems to clear space. Game gets extremely boring by the end of thr 3rd level. Boredom sets in after Level 1. Rating is my experience. You might find it different. Gave this game a fair chance to show how it can be interesting. Sadly, variation on a theme.

It has a great story, and it's a good looking merge game, but once you hit level 30, the cost in coins to complete build quests gets very steep, and progress grinds to a halt. The cooldown on the producers is extremely annoying and feels greedy in the dev's end. The constant baiting with card set events feels pointlessly cyclic, since all you do is get energy to use producers, to fill orders to get coins, to build stuff to get gems to buy energy to produce stuff to fill orders...

They've recently changed the way the levels work on the game, I'm assuming due to the point no one was getting anywhere in the game. I had contacted support recently over a lagging issue with the game that was taking my merged products, but weren't clearing the task. They responded twice, didn't respond further, and didn't rectify the issue. Game is ok, customer service is very mislead/poor.

The update made on 10/26 is HORRIBLE! You have literally disrupted the format that made this game enjoyable. I was almost done with completing my globe, giraffe, & cheese wheel. Those were high payout items that I've spent a lot of time getting there just for you guys to change it! Now the auto-generators take forever, they give out very little merge items, & the new auto orders don't give great perks and payouts! As soon as this Halloween card game is done, I am quiting this game for good!

STAY AWAY!!! You can put hours and energy into progressing through the pieces and the game will, "have an anomaly," that takes your highest piece away. Thei4 solution was to give me 25 energy. It cost me more than 2048 to get the piece I was at. They say that it is a free game, but you can't achieve daily goals without spending money and I don't have any. I'm filing a lawsuit.

I downloaded several games like this to try all around the same time, and Travel Town was one of the worst. The insatiably greedy model makes it 0 fun. Without spending an inordinate amount of money, you simply are not even able to complete the daily tasks--let alone special events. It's bulky and demanding. It's so little fun to play that after giving it about 2 weeks, I removed it for good. Developers need to give it a massive rework.

I really enjoy this game, but will simply play it less if there's less energy. A few days ago, the game suddenly stopped its daily offers of 25 energy in exchange for an ad watch. It also stopped offering ad watches for items in bubbles. It's a bummer, b/c now progress is slower than snail's pace. Is there any change this is a bug, not a feature?

I was at level 35. I started over because the game was going and I couldn't get the fossil. Edit: Started over again from level 63 this time. The game has been improved. However, the energy is still a problem. It gets harder to complete one task. Ik a lot more persons who have un-installed for other reasons. Overall, it's an amazing game. It's addictive and I think that's the frustrating bit because I obsess easily. But amazing game. Fix the energy, like when we log in, give us a welcome back 🎁

Fair warning: extended game play w/o purchasing additional energy is impossible. The amount of items you must merge to complete orders is large & most producers drop more than one set of items. You spend a lot of energy very fast. Nevertheless, I enjoy playing. I wish you had the option to delete orders & receive new ones. There are no pop up ads.

Could be a fun game but the amount of pop ups that are asking you for money is insane! I wish there was a way to tell you that I am never spending money on your game so stop asking me! Opting to watch ads for bonuses is enough! I play this game now and then but the pop ups remind me how much of a pain it can be to play. Also events never run long enough. Sounds spoilt but it is what it is and there are games out there that are making money without annoying you to death.

Pottery doesn't merge. In order to make an order, you need to spend too many energy on unnecessary items -algorithm?- you get frustrated, so the game loses its purpose which it is supposed to be relaxing. It is relaxinf in the beginning because everything seems too easy and perfect, then, you spend 400 energy to build a one fish. It is ridiculous.

Fun game, seems to be a lot to unlock. My main complaint is the energy. It takes over 3 hours to fully refill your energy if you don't want to spend money. Fully refilled is 100, and each click takes 1-2 energy. The gems go quickly when you use it to buy energy which again is something you hardly get without spending money. They need to implement either a shorter energy regen or other means to get energy, like more than 2 or 3 ads a day you can watch

Decent game, too bad it's a huge money grab. The latest update seems to have removed any and all optional ads for energy/items. Previously I could play for 20-30 minutes at a time, with the ads. Now there's only about 5-10 minutes of gameplay before 3+ hours of forced downtime waiting for your energy to refill if you're not willing to shell out $4 every 5 minutes or buy loads of gems.

The game used to be fun so I downloaded it across all of my devices. Now at level 14 you will play for days waiting on enough tokens to complete one order without buying more tokens. It used to be a higher level. I guess their idea of a fix was to make the problem at a lower level now. Do not download it if you do not plan on spending money.

The game is fun. I got sucked into it but there is a glitch with one particular ad where it kicks you out & doesn't credit the energy, etc. I brought this to their attention & the first time Bryan credited the energy points. But when it kept happening, Armin just blew me off & said they were working on it. When I asked for my credits, he insisted I got them all as if I was lying or crazy. How hard is it to give me points that cost them nothing after making money off me watching ads? So done!!!

I really liked this game but I'm start to get annoyed and thinking of deleting it. I never spend a money on a game before but because I liked this game so much I made some purchases. The thing is if I spend €5 or even more I expect to finish at least 5-10 orders and get some bonuses. But few last times I spend money and didn't get much further in a game. There could be more ways how to get free energy and diamonds.

When I first started playing this, I was sure it was going to be a pay to win kinda game. Gives you a bucket-load of energy to begin with, then really slows down. No freebie energy at midnight at all, like most merge games. But once you hit about level 15, the game really begins to flow. Always keep two generators of the same type, is my best advice I can give ya, if you're interested in playing. It really turns out to be great merge game. =)

Game is nice, but know that after you get to a certain level, (above 50), the game will decide not to open for days on end. All the notification I get when try to launch the game is, "no network detected. Try again," when I use mobile data or connected to a blazing fast WiFi. This happens about 4 days out of 7. I'm going to be uninstalling this

I only wish it was easier to get energy! Other than that, it's a great game. Well thought out with attractive themes, and the bonus event games are my favorite. Waiting for energy to reload can be a drag, but it also helps you to not spend too much time playing so you can go do something else. Friendly user interface, chances to win prizes via their social media. Awesome Mysteries along the way.

Like so many others I really want to love this game fully. I came on and read reviews and waited before I made mine because I figured the developer would be making changes. They did, it still sucks. The resources needed to find items, finding resources. It's almost like they are greedy and just want you to spend real money to play the game. Maybe they want it to be a challenge but the challenges are about impossible which ends up making the game frustrating. And pottery wheel=😤🤬

The game, UI, experience is all quite fun, addictive and diverting but u really can't achieve any of the higher and fun targets unless u pay $$ hence the 3 stars. There's no realistic way for someone to win without paying overtime or inviting loads of friend. The makers should make the game more accessible. Not having too many ads is a positive though. The intermediate items that you get in the levels are interesting but at the end of the day the whole thing feels pointless

I've been playing for 5 days, I'm at level 21 and I think I'm done. Way too many things going on at once that crowd the board. I only have 4 available spaces so nothing is getting done and items are taking way to long to recharge. This game would be much better if the board was way bigger. The small board and having to wait makes the game way too slow going. Its unfortunate because this could have been a fun and addicting game to play.

You'll play this game for 2h max, after which progress will slow down to a crawl, and the game tries to get you to buy micro-transactions left right and center. I played it today and had to close 6 in-game ads right at the beginning of launching the game. After putting in 2h, i got stuck and have played at least 2+ more hours. I've still yet to get anywhere.

Tbh I used to love this game, but the devs became more and more greedy. Well, no big deal since I play free and never intend to give money to these cash-grab games, so I played just to complete the collections. But they have made it harder and harder to get energy or free gems: bubbles no longer give energy, daily challenges require more orders completed,... there's just no fun to play the game, it feels like chore. Hence, 1 star and uninstall. Do better and be less greedy, devs

The main problem with the game is that there is no change in the maximum reach of energy as we progress(It is 100). As we go forward the game will get tougher, tasks are impossible and have to wait days to complete it as well as the daily and weekly challenges. The game forces us to spend money for energy and diamonds. Its a request to extend the energy limit from 100 to more as we progress. Moreover this is a game and we r not going to spend money for that. Please entertain us than challenging.

Played for a month, now I'm done with this trash game. The game makes you depend on energy to play and it refills so slow and it costs so much energy to play it! It takes almost 4 hours to fill 100 energy and once it is full you go play and spend all the 100 energy in 5 minutes then you need to wait 4 hours again to play (or pay with real money to get energy). There's no ads but it is literally P2P (pay to play), which in my opinion is as bad as having ads. Would give negative stars if possible.

I've enjoyed playing this game daily for awhile now - and I frequently rely on watching ads to get more energy or items....but the ads keep freezing and I either have to restart the game or it takes me back to game play- either way, I don't get the energy or the product. I've updated the game, restarted my phone...nothing I do fixes it. Ads run just fine in other games I play. This is so frustrating!!!

I love this game. But the most recent update has removed strategy play and forces players to have to spend money in order to advance at any pace that is enjoyable. Having the chests auto open and immediately go into your energy and gem bar means you can't save for later to be able to merge instead you're stuck with what you get and removes the fun entirely. Every update seems to be designed with money grabbing in mind and makes me less inclined to recommend the game

I have been playing this game for almost a year and have enjoyed it, but with the recent update I am very disappointed with there being no energy when the bubble pops and less rewards for reaching new levels. Please change this back to the way it was Also certain players who have certain rewards like the inventory storage, why was this not rolled out to everyone at the same time? This is extremely unfair. I have been waiting for almost a month, constantly checking for updates hoping to get it.

Great game but becomes boring pretty quickly when game play is all of a couple of minutes before you've used up all your energy. Orders become all rarer items so takes even longer to get to them. You can watch some ads for extra energy but only a few times then you need to buy. Even purchasing energy gives you very little game play unless you're prepared to spend a lot...just another game like this.

4 stars until you get to higher levels. Then it's 2 1/2 star rating. Because then, as most players have stated, you need more and more merges to get what you need but run out of moves and diamonds. Shame, but typical and not exclusive to this game. Also, the pottery task RUINS the game more so than any other complaint I have. It's awful and you should be ashamed for having added it.

I love this game alot. I have reached high enough levels that it takes an extreme amount of energy to complete orders. I have also noticed with probulay 100 dollars worth of purchases to get to 60 like I am. The 2.99 purchase gets most then its like oh 4.99 or 5.99 ain't bad. But after all I have spent in the last 3 days the lowest costing energy is 7.99 and up. I would give 5 stars on this game because I am so addicted to it. But at this cost will have to delete it before my husband disown me.

Addictive but unplayable as you level up. I did spend money on this game because I loved it, but ultimately you run out of space on your board. The old generating items you no longer need or use cannot be deleted and end up taking all your storage. I was at level 60 I think but deleted it because there was literally no where to put anything. I would have been happy to continue to pay for a fun game

I've been playing for a couple days, and was able to reach about level 15 pretty quickly, but the energy system really ruins the fun of the game and limits your daily progression which in my opinion isn't great. Would be 100 times better without any energy at all. The graphics are cute and nicely done, and the whole idea of the game is just amazing, love it, but it's ruined by a simple mechanic.

This game is addictive. But very quickly, you get over it because, as you progress and get on higher levels, completing orders and getting rewards becomes extremely difficult without spending actual money. Forget about completing daily or weekly challenges. Sometimes, it takes days to complete just one order. I would give 2 stars just because it's a fun game with no ads.

It was not the game that was advertised, which is why I downloaded it. I wanted to see if I passed a level if the other game would appear, and I had a $20 balance on my Google Play gift card, so I bought $1.99 worth of gems. My balance is now down to less than $5. Google Play confirms I only purchased $1.99. So, whether intentional or the game was packable, I lost $13 trying out this game.

I love the game but there are some flaws. The board is too small and there's a lot of things to merge. I don't want to sell or delete some items because when I do, I end up needing them later. Also, can you please put description on the inventory book? Like items should selectable and there will be a description below. The time of the recharge should be indicated also when the item is recharging so that I know when to go back whenever I need to wait for it.

In short, it's annoying. What the game lacks in ads, it makes up for in the inability to do anything after a certain point. When you first start playing, energy is easy to refill due to the rewards, and item merging eats at that energy at a reasonable rate. It doesn't take long for all of that to go away. Aside from event rewards replacing energy/coin rewards, now items require a ridiculous amount of merging to even get another item that produces what you actually need for a task.

It's fun, however they should allow gold card trading or don't give multiple gold cards. Does not make any sense to get duplicates you can't trade. And you should be able to trade to at least two friends a day not just one. It takes to long to complete orders. And I really hate when I need one of the special drops and you use so much energy and it never comes. It's too expensive. The card game gives entirely too many duplicates. The island game, the points needed is too high.

Used to be a great game, if a little slow. But the latest update is a total MONEY GRAB. As others have said, the rewards for leveling up have dropped SIGNIFICANTLY and now the extra bubbles only give coins? It's obvious what the intent was there. I understand apps need to profit, but don't screw over the players or you'll lose them! Would like to see an adjustment that's more of a compromise. Hoping they'll take the feedback from players seriously.

Buyer beware!! Bought a special that had energy, gems, chests, and card packs. Something happened with their system, and I didn't get chests or card packs. I bought this to get more cards. So they didn't offer me anything for the items missing they were just like "sorry, nothing we can do." So before you buy, make sure you get ALL the stuff you paid for!!! They won't get any more of my money until that make this right. I couldn't get my albums finished because of this.

I will be deleting game. In the beginning it was fun but now I have come to realize that the only way I'm going to progress is if I spend money which I am not going to do. The items in the bubbles are requesting ridiculous amounts of gems to pop (ie 150).My board is completely filled and I can't merge anything. I started deleting some items but that's no fun.

I'm enjoying this game for a couple of months until now. But please could you fix some bugs coz my diamonds and some other items are lost in the inventory. I noticed it . There is a certain box that keep on losing items. And i hope you bring it back coz I can't combine a certain item to maximum level when that item is losing. Thank you and please arrange it . Its really an amazing game to play who's introvert like me. 🙏🙏🙏

I enjoy the theme and general game play for this merge game. As is similar to other merge games, the way to progress the story is to earn coins by filling orders from customers by merging the raw items made by producers. The less-than-optimal element is that, at any given time, I can't fill half (or more) of the orders can't because I don't have the producers that can make those raw items. The game should be programmed so that customers only order items I can actually make.

I really enjoy this game, but unfortunately it's become impossible to complete challenges without spending money. Even if it were just really hard that would be one thing, but it's actually physically impossible to do it because you don't get enough energy within 24 hours to complete challenges - you have to buy more energy if you want to do it, or take several days to build up a store of items (and even that's not guaranteed to work). It's quite disappointing, really :(

Honestly not worth downloading unless you like merge games with little movement. Not to mention if you even stop for half a second to look at what's on your board it immediately tries to get you to merge certain items, even if merging them means messing up an order. Really annoying. Ads never work, you'll watch an ad for energy but won't get it. Plus you don't even get check in rewards like other merge games. Just tasks that can't be completed without $$$. Overall could be done a LOT better.

It's pretty fun. There is also story group chat between the characters that seems fun, but I skip that just to play. Lots to collect in-game "stickers". Energy time out is annoying, but they've got to do something to get you to pay (buy jewels to buy energy). No ads though, so I think that's fair. Update after a few days: Because the products get more complicated to make im pretty much stuck with no option but to play for ten minutes every 3 hours (to wait for free energy cause I won't pay)

I've been scaling back on playing this. It's really not enjoyable. 1st I game I ever played where you can't even come close to finishing daily tasks, because of that you miss out on so many rewards, (in game event rewards too), and it takes DAYS to complete orders because there's not enough stamina. Very frustrating.

I was really liking the game at first. I didn't mind waiting to make items. Stuck on level 30 even bought some gems. I get the pay to play idea... feels like this game is going to cost a fortune. Wish the game gave more of what is needed to move forward. I even bought the starter pack that contained a green energy chest. That was groovy till it disappeared. If you buy something like that you should be able to keep it, seeing that it cost $6. Don't think I will continue much longer.

Don't waste your time once you're level 25 or over you won't be able to finish any quests because it's impossible with the generators to get the item you're looking for. And whatever algorithm is set to it is extremely unfair to the player, if you need a less common item some generators won't produce it even after spending 100+ energy with ads. I understand that's the point to encourage spending money but it's so frustrating and defeats the purpose of a relaxing game i have more 2 say but Im cut

I am fed up with the fountain for fish!! I have built it 4 times and still can't complete one order. Energy gets wasted on item generators producing so much of one item. Cook pot for ex: If I use 1 energy, almost every item is a yogurt to be merged. If set at 2 energy, almost every item is a cappuccino cup. I have to keep getting rid of them because I have no room on my board, not enough room in inventory, and I am not spending 10 gems for another spot. Energy is gone trying to create one item.

Not enough variety in the items you recieve and some of the power items have too many different outputs and you waste money trying to create the items. I use to like the game but it's not really fun the higher the levels get. I hope this changes bc I'm not wasting anymore money to just keep getting the same items and I can't get the big prizes. Finally it takes entirely too long to get more power bolts. 1 bolt for every 2 mins and the max is 100. I have to wait 3 hours and 20 mins to reach max
