Read FB reviews, STAY AWAY! Takes a lot longer to reach goals, you can't reach dailys anymore unless you pay. They keep adding more levels to get 1 item but only allow 2 trades per day and to get 1 item or close to 1 item, it takes all your game energy so YOU'RE DONE PLAYING in less than 3 minutes then you have to wait hours before getting enough to play for another 3 mins and still never get the daily -_- Soon as this album ends I'll be deleting the game.

NOT AS ADVERTISED!!! I saw and played an ad for this game that was basically like a merge game + Tetris. Very unique! So I downloaded it. I got to level 14 or 15, and it's just a typical merge game, much like Merge Mansion. Don't get me wrong; it's a great game--fun, cute, and very well designed. If you like merge games, you'll love this one! But don't expect anything unique like from the ads. I'll be uninstalling this game because I don't like being deceived by ads.

I dislike the refresh time it takes to continue playing, the shop is not cost-effective for those who have limited income. Add other ways to earn more life. Completing tasks restricts advancement. Advancement costs money, money that many, including me too can't afford to spend to enjoy playing this game. Which causes me to be less likely to recommend let alone want to come back and play? More games should be more about the people rather than profit

I used to enjoy Merge games, but the more Merge games come out, the more boring and repetitive they seem to be. This one is no exception. Same game, different background (beach town). Small board that fills up quickly. Requests that are easy to fill at first and then get "harder"...aka more time consuming, and it takes ages to tap 1000 times to get the bits you need. Does anyone actually enjoy just tapping a screen over and over? In my opinion, the best merge game is Merge Dragons.

It's a fun game at the beginning addicting. But the more you get on higher levels the more you'll get hung up. The prices of the diamonds and energy packs are ridiculous as a lot of times you need hundreds and thousands of energy for a single order. This is for a very rich man's game. Will have to uninstall soon.

The game is nice at first, until the items in the inventory keep on disappering lately. Hope you can solve the problem very soon. Edited: The developer asked me to email the support team.. yes, I did that before.. but nothing happened.. while the items in my inventory keep on disappearing even more. Please resolve my problem 😐 i still wanna play the game

The new update was unfairly converted. I spent at least 500 energy to collect a medal from the dog house, and they got rid of it and gave me 2 engery in place of the item. That's theft, especially if you spent real money for engery. Give a proper evaluation for the items we spent so much engery on just for you to update the game and give us nothing for all the hard work and time we put into playing, and all the Real money spent on engery and diamonds.

The concept is fine to pass the time and can be addictive. However, it is virtually impossible to complete any challenges without spending cash, and quite a bit of it. If you don't make regular in game purchases, the game is very slow and gets boring. So my message is, don't get fooled, it's a bottomless pit. I made a couple of purchases, but the advantage i got was very short-lived.

Got to lvl 27 and now I have enough. Board gets way too cluttered with all the different things you need to match, chains are annoying and confusing, all the time you have cooldowns on the generators, because they get exhausted so fast. Events are impossible to finish without spendig way more than you get back. I'm done with games like this. I recommend not wasting your time with downloading this game. Uninstalled.

The 100 energy bar is too small for higher levels. Can't make enough items to do daily tasks. It's pay to win. The energy bar should get bigger as your level gets higher. Someone spent two months making an order. You play for a couple of minutes then you have to spend money or leave. It's not fun anymore & not relaxing. Going back to township- no ads, long playtime, build a city, only spend 💰 when I want to & join co-op with other people. This game offers less but wants way more 💰. Greedy.

This game is kinda fun and satisfying at the beginning but it gets frustrating and lame quick...... unless you spend money. It's definitely set up to be enjoyable at first but it doesn't take long before you pretty much have to spend money. Super lame. Confused how it has any good ratings. Probably from people getting satisfaction from power ups they had to spend money on. It's easy to spend wayyyyyyy too much money on. Good for them BAD for you!!!!!!

I love this game. It's addictive in a relaxing sort of way. I've been playing every day since I downloaded it (like a week ago?) and I'm almost at lvl 26. The board can get full, but I like the challenge of trying to get things done in a tiny space. I love that the energy recharges rather quickly and there are always different ways of accumulating more energy on the side. Very fun and enjoyable game. Great job developers!!

Fun, but...it only loads 100 "lighting bolts"(your usable turns) at a time, which makes your playable time extremely short, without having to spend money. I would rather watch additional ads for more turns (more than the 25 that it gives: 25 equals 12 moves if you're playing doubles) than have to wait hours to play again and make movement. The more you play, the more you are expected to spend....about to give up and cut my losses 🤷‍♀️

Fun game. However, it takes way too much energy to merge common items, and there's no way to gift friends energy. Plus, when friends are gifted items such as collection cards, there's no place to see those cards, no way to show you/they received the gifts. Due to the incredibly high levels of energy required and the lack of cooperative play, I will likely end up uninstalling this game.

I was loving this game until the pottery came out. 8 energy to get one item and half the time it's a broken one that takes 5 more energy to get rid of and you can't cancel orders with those items to skip them. It's too bad, cause I really loved the game but I'm not going to play anymore because of that.

Have been enjoying this game for a while...until now. I thought the pottery thing was a bit interesting but so many clicks of energy for 1 item is annoying - maybe 2 or 3 is fine but 4, 5 or 6 clicks is rubbish. This is especially so when a broken item comes through. You have to click several times just to get 1 coin therefore more energy wasted. The item can't be deleated or sold either. Game now uninstalled.

It's a lot of fun, at the start, but at some point basically impossible to progress without paying. You'll only get a bit of power by watching ads but the ads sometimes are completely closing the game with ends in me watching the ad without getting the energy i was supposed to get because the game had to reset. Also some point you have a whole bunch of creators that you don't need for challenges and will just fill up your board. Graphics and story are cute and isn't as annoying as in some.

Its a fun game to waste time. I try not to put too much money into it but after about 6 months of consistent playtime, I've gotten about as much enjoyment as I would a steam game and put about the equivalent into the game financially. Animations are cute and the story line is great. You can tell the devs put a lot of thought into themes and the art team really makes great characters, items, and environments. I think the only feedback I would offer is to have longer "travel" events.

Really liked this game initially. I needed a way to kill some time, and this was great. But as I leveled up (for which there is no reward), it has now become a game I can only play in about 3 minute stints. That's how quickly I burn through the energy, with no way to get more other than wait for hours. (I do not have real money to spend on something like this). Will be looking for a game I can play for a little longer than 3 minutes a couple of times a day.

It's super addictive yet the amount of energy you get at a time is ridiculous. Why is there a cap on the energy you can get while offline? And why does it take 2 minutes to gain 1 energy? This makes it impossible to play the game for more than 5 minutes. It's also not worth it to use gems or money on energy because it takes mere minutes to lose again. I mean, seriously, overlooked and horrible idea. It's a shame, too, because I enjoy the game and don't have any other problems.

Love this game! But definitely has quite a few glitches that need to be worked out. 1) the game constantly kicks you out when you're about to get a reward and then you go back in the game and the reward is gone! 😩 2) not enough time to pop the bubble to get the other item to use for merge. 3) some of the items you merge you don't get credit for.

It's actually pretty fun. There isn't near enough energy or ways to get more energy to even come close to complete daily activities. It needs to have a way to request energy from ur gaming friends and a way to trade our duplicates with fellow players. Being able to create a team would help this all around. Idk about anyone else, but 100 energy then 1 free every 2 minutes (when it takes at least 40 to create anything in higher levels) just isn't enough for anything! Seriously takes the fun away!

I was really liking this game for a bit, but they keep changing how some of the "special" items are acquired. like, I hate the fact that you get an amount of the item, it has a blue waiting period, a second amount of items, and then the red waiting period. I wish it would go back to just letting us get them in one go and having us wait for the next batch in totality

Incredibly greedy game. It becomes terribly slow to move ahead without paying cash. It gives you the illusion that it is incredibly generous at first but after a while, you will run out of energy just playing for 5 minutes at a time and are forced to wait for it to restart or pay. I have paid because merging was satisfying but I'm not willing to pay more than what I already have. This is definitely a pay to win game.

Not at all like the ads. You have to tap a icon for it to disperse objects to merge. Each tap requires energy. You can watch ads for a couple of times to get free energy that will not last long. It doesn't take long before you can't make progress unless you want to spend money/wait for your energy to refill. Maybe this is a better revenue model than allowing ad revenue. But it's the fastest way for me to uninstall a game.

Great concept, poor execution. The game just doesn't move forward once you reach level 10 or so... The items to fulfill in the "orders" require such a monstrous number of matches, and the "ingredients" which pop out of the bags/chests are such basic ones, that xp get used up without any visible progress. Devs got a bit too greedy on this one. There's no way it's going to get the popularity it deserves with this amount of waste - waste of both time and money.

use to work great but now it constantly freezes and when it starts up again I'm missing items I had just accumulated. It does this so much its no longer fun its stressful. So if you like to be hung out to dry this is your app. Good luck. this is an add on... It's worse now. And my friend joined the game and I never received the diamonds they claim to give you.

I was really enjoying this game, now at level 58, but have been unable to clear a single order in almost a week bc the items I need (that used to pop up regularly) just don't show up anymore. I'm at a standstill and unwilling to put anymore time, energy, or money into this game. It was fun while it lasted!

App is constantly crashing. If I'm lucky, I can quickly merge one item before it crashes. Sometimes I'll attempt to watch ads for rewards if the game hasn't crashed in a while, only for it to crash and I lose out on the reward, but can't watch another video for a reward because it counted. Other games work great, this is the only one I have issues with.

Game keeps crashing, won't allow me to redeem a joker card, crashes at every attempt. Can't contact them as their system won't accept my email address. Very poor customer service. Update: Problem righted itself, I just kept trying untill it stopped crashing, stubborn perseverance. Should be able to contact you through the app. Forcing me to make public complaints seems counterproductive.

The merging part of the game is fun, but there is no real incentive or acknowledgement for the player to keep playing as you get to a higher level. The pottery wheel is ridiculous, as it uses all your energy for very little pay out. You can't complete goals in a reasonable amount of time once you're in the mid 20's plus, as you're constantly out of energy. Don't want to pay money for premium currency when it's expensive and I won't get much in return for it. Fun game for a bit, that's about it.

If you're playing a game to kill time, this is not the game. You have to wait too long to build energy. I haven't even reached level 20 and I probably won't. No need to waste space on my phone. The lack of ads is great. However, the lack of space on the board, as well as the amount of time for your energy to recharge and energy to disburse items is 2 time-consuming. This is not a game to kill time.

The game is fun but after a certain level you'll need to spend money more than not to get through the daily challenges. What I find disrespectful is that they have an algorithm where if you spend money they increase the cost of everything until you go about a week without purchases, then they offer low prices. They need to offer better rewards for people that spend cash. There's also an issue where they seem to always give you more items that you never need. Not a coincidence, burns energy fast.

This used to be my favorite merge game out of the many I play. However, the recent changes make it impossible to hit daily or weekly goals without spending a lot of real $$. If you guys were smart you would fix this... listen to your unhappy player base. Some of us used to actually buy gems to help us complete tasks, but never will again.

It was fun to play initially, but by level 20 it becomes very monotonous. You lack the resources to complete orders, your board fills up, and you have to sell items due to limited space. Energy is scarce unless you watch ads or pay. This leads to wasting time waiting for recharges. The game seems designed to push you to spend money. Playing becomes impractical as it demands too much time to fulfill repetitive orders without the necessary ingredients. I'm likely uninstalling soon. 😕

Just made sure I had the latest update, still not working. I have been waiting almost a month to play this again. Checking updates to see if the crash has been fixed and it's not. I had put money into the game just before the crashing trouble started. I was hoping it was fixed by now. Update: The game freezes before I can get to a menu. It either freezes at the load or as soon as I tap to get to menu.

Started out fun but has gotten boring. I can't complete the daily challenge because getting orders complete is impossible. Like a lot of merge games, they push for you to use diamonds to speed up the wait on appliances. The wait time is inconsistent. Since I can't complete any task, which would earn me energy boxes and smiley faces to upgrade buildings, the game is boring.

Extremely addictive. Not rewarding. Avoid if you are easily addicted to games, especially if you have a habit of spending money on games. The challenges/goals are not attainable without spending money no matter what strategy you use. Another player aptly used the term "enslavement" - this "game" preys heavily on it's users willingness to become entrapped in a hollow cycle of goal-oriented accomplishment. Even if you don't spend money, you will pay heavily with your time and attention.

Ive been playing this for several months and usually I grow bored of games quickly but didn't with this one. Recently, changes have been made that make me consider just deleting it altogether. On the special games the tiered prizes are not as good as they were, when you get the bonus items they give coins instead of energy, and no longer give chest of energy when leveling up. Just rather disappointing, they're seeming to try to force people to buy things and that's when I delete the apps.

The game started out fun, it quickly became a money grab. As you progressed some things you could only tap 5 times and it would turn yellow for an hour refresh when you hadn't played at all that day. Prompting you to buy gems to speed it up. It's clear they try to hook you into continually playing then just wanting you to spend money. I enjoyed it for a few weeks then uninstalled.

Fun game, but you wait 3+ hours for energy to play and use that energy within 10 minutes. There are ads to watch for more energy, but looks like you only get 3 ads to watch for 1/4 of the energy, every 24 hours. You wait more to play than you can actually play the game. The only way to recharge the energy, which you use up super super fast without even being able to move forward thereafter, is through buying energy. Is it worth downloading if you can't play as and when you please?

Game Play is fun but forward progress is stagnated. Orders arent varied enough so you spend time waiting for the generators to recharge, w/o ever zero-ing out your energy. I'd rather use all my energy & make progress than having to wait on the gens to fulfill 1 order. I'm uninstalling b/c the game takes too long to load, especially it's own internal pop up ads. It can take up to 2 minutes between initializing the game & being able to make a single merge.

Fun at first but takes way too much energy to complete an item. You get 1 energy every 2 minutes, you can merge once per 1 energy. You have to make so many and merge so many items before you get to the maxed level of an item. There shouldn't be so many levels to one section of items as it makes you HAVE to P2P. I've been doing this for 3 days and I'll probably play way less now due to these issues.

I have to give this game one star down from 5. It's a fun game. However, I don't like that they continuously pause my progress in merging items for things I need to make in order to win diamonds or merge tools I need to build in levels of the game. When I'm merging it says "recharging." sure, I can work on something else. But that something else isn't what I need in the moment to progress in the game. And it wastes my energy because we only get 100 energy bars. after awhile I get bored.

The game is fun anyway, The daily challenge has been designed in a way that it is impossible to complete without spending. The energy keeps being exhausted quickly due to the large amount of merging needed to get a particular item. They always request the items at the highest level of merge and keep supplying you the 1st level so you need to merge A LOT to get to the last level and halfway there, the energy is sure to be zero. I've got a job too, ya know? We can't sit waiting for energy all day!

While the game is mostly pay to progress, there was one consistent way of making enough money to fill up the daily quota - auto orders. Some hard-to-obtain items, like the lamp generator's Globe and the Fishing Net's Pisces Pendant, would make a very rewarding auto-order pop up once you've obtained them. These items that would take either hundreds of energy or otherwise many days to obtain, have just had their auto order rewards cut by 90%. Game feels dead now. Nothing to work or save up for.

The game is fun but you need to remove the charging. Its hard enough with the limited space on the board. I am not spending time waiting for reaching and definitely not paying for a couple of minutes playing. Also I downloaded the game because of the video I saw of you dropping shells and merging them but this is not that game? This was not that game. I'm confused. Will have to stop now because it's not enjoyable and misleading with the add.

It's a good merge game with no ads, I do get very annoyed with the limited energy and how much things cost to merge. The trade carding is so silly, having to be on their Facebook page to connect with strangers to trade cards. I think being able to trade through the app instead of Facebook would be much better as well as potentially being able to request cards from friends via the app instead of Facebook. If you don't have Facebook don't get the game.

I love this game and would give it more higher rating if it weren't for the mysterious fossil that I can't get. It's been there since the beginning. I'm level 88, and STILL can't complete it. I've looked it up and the thing you need to get it is so rare, and the father that you get into the game, the harder that it is to complete. They need to get rid of this mission or make it easier to obtain it shouldn't take over 88 levels.

I really like the game I've been playing for a while, but recently, it seems to have gotten so hard it's almost impossible to finish missions unless you spend cash. You rarely get what you need. As soon as you merge something that's been on your board for a month to make room you end up needing it immediately and can't get it. If you like this game I would recommend merge sweets. Way easier to get energy and finish missions.

The game was really fun at the beginning. But it's clear the creators are solely focused on making money. It's impossible to progress in the game with how hard the levels are and the low amount of energy given. All the want is for you to buy anything, pretty sad that they have to ruin a game by being incredibly greedy. 👎👎👎👎👎

Very satisfying merge game with good progression and optional ads. However I keep running into an issue where about half the time when I try to watch an ad to regain some energy or open a bubble, the ad won't play. I get am inescapable black screen that I have to force quit and reload the game for, and then I don't get the reward, nor even a chance to re attempt the add. Very frustrating.

I really enjoy this game a lot. The only reason it is not 5 stars is that there is no way to advance or complete the special events without spending real money. I also don't like that I need to add random strangers to my Facebook as friends in order to trade cards with them. There needs to be an option to find people on the game or do what fishdom does and have groups you can join and speak to in the game itself.

Don't waste your time. This game is just frustrating once you get past a certain level. You can't really play for more than a few minutes at a time without paying money. Even then you just get ripped off. Worst game ever. I was only playing for fetch rewards but the amount of time to complete levels is ridiculous. At least 2 days per level if not more.

Very fun and addictive game. The problem is, it's great in the beginning... but then you basically only get 2-3 minutes of play time each day unless you want to fork over actual dollars. You earn one energy per every two minutes, with a maximum of 100 energy total. (So if I have 98 energy before going to bed, tomorrow I only earned 2 energy for a total of 100). Guess how much play time you get for 100 energy? 100 clicks of a button. Think about how miniscule that play time is. Uninstalled!

Now that I have reached level 72 I am here with my review of this game. Have been playing since 8 months or so. Initially it was fun to engage in this game. But now that I have crossed level 68 onwards this game has become so boring. There isn't any incentive of being at higher level. Nothing but frustration. It takes a good 3-4 days to finish one task. No perks. No bonus. Only 100 energies. This game is pathetic and petty. Atleast add some perks. The side quests are also so boring.

It gets boring when you reach higher levels (30 onwards) reason being tasks that are really hard to complete. Daily tasks cannot be completed within the given time frame with the little energy we get. It's talking about 300 plus energy to complete a task. You get lots n lots of duplicates, making it impossible to complete all the albums. It's been days that I received any new stickers. Really disappointing 😕

it's ok. It's a bit fun but on a mechanical level i don't like that there's a 'rotating cast' of generators you eventually don't use anymore and put away, and the kitchen robot being used so much and having three item chains AND only giving out like 6-8 items at a time is really limiting and frustrating. I've probably hit the artificial wall where they want you to spend money but its still frustrating just conceptually. it takes SIX⚡ for ONE pottery item. SIX. im actually MORE angry now.

This game gets frustrating to play very quickly. Around level 12 or 13, you can't even play for that long because the energy levels run out. The board gets full quickly, and the in-game cost of purchasing inventory space is high. The cost to replace the energy is also high, considering how quickly the energy runs out. Also, the higher level the order, the higher the level of items spawned from the buckets should be. And $10 for a starter pack? Outrageous.

It was OK to start but levelling up became a huge chore and the game became too time consuming and very much unplayable. The illustration updates was the first strike - who in their right minds redesigned some of these items? Beyond level 30-40+, this game has become nothing short of a money grab; pay-to-play to progress any further. Also approving these shoddy two/three-worded, one-sentence vague 5-star reviews that you consider "awesome feedback" is quite silly.

The worst game I've ever played. Extra difficult daily tasks, huuuge amounts of coins needed to play and level up. Items disappearing from the board between reloads. My tablet freezes during the game and getting extra warm (issues not present with other games I play) - not optimized at all. Based on reviews, this used to be a fun game until recently - I can see why.

Good game. The only thing that I don't like is when things like "Steven's Disco" come around, you never TRULY get a chance at higher prizes without paying for it. I ALWAYS land on the 25 energy...NEVER anything better. That makes this come across as rigged to me, and if you don't have the chance for anything better without paying for it, then we're better off without it.

Pottery wheel. The devs intentionally made it extremely frustrating. It's already annoying that all item spawners make two kinds of items, and when you need one kind, they only give you the other kind, forcing you to spend energy. But now, the pottery wheel takes more energy than any other spawner, and it spawns FAILURES that cost MORE energy to dispose! You can't have your inventory space back without spending more energy! WHY?! Discarding anything else is free! It's ruined the game for me.

I'll rate is at a 2 star because it's a 'pay to play' (or wait forever if you don't buy something). I'd actually like to get a chance to PLAY this game. I can play for 5 minutes, then i have to wait for 3-4 hours for the insanely slow Energy to charge again. Yes, i can pay money for diamonds to buy energy, but even if i buy, it's +5 more minutes of game time. That's it. Only a few tries a day to watch ads for Energy, then it's dead. I can't say it's a time killer. A huge dissapontent

Update: I've been on level 78 for a year now. I play 3 times a day and I'm still not even close to beating the level. You have to pay to progress. Download if you are rich and can spend hundreds of dollars if not more.

Have been playing this game for several months. I usually lose interest quickly but haven't with this one. With that said, SUPER unhappy with the latest update. I don't like the changes of the look of the coins & gems which isn't a big deal, but what is a big deal is changing the game that not unlocking items now gives you coins instead of energy like it used to. Really really don't like that. May be a deal breaker for me.

I really love this game, but recently it is not doin well. The change of the bubbles of energy with gold it was a bad idea. When i see an add to get free items from the bubbles or free energy, right after the add is end, the app shuts down unexpectly and i have to reopen again, off course with no reward. It shows often the connection problem, while i can play every other game perfectly... If none of this issues will not be solved, sorry to say that I'm gonna delete the game...

This game is so addicting when you get going. However my issue is when they give limited time challenges. And it really isn't hard. But when you need to use a producer that gives 2+ items you NEVER get the items you actually need. And I can't help but think it is by design. I blew through 200+ diamonds and so many energies to try to get to the 1 item. When the challenge to end, I had 9 gems left but the challenge was incomplete. I understand probability well, but that is just ridiculous man.

Started out fun... Now I have a full screen always... Out of storage as it's full of construction stuff I can't sell that is to get properties I can't do anything with. There are no side games most other games have to break the boredom. Everything I need is such high level I would have to buy energy to get even one, for no real benifit. I even have a couple of forever items with no clue how or where to even get. Two stars is too high... Bye.

It's frustratingly close to being fun. It's very pretty, and somewhat satisfying. I enjoyed it for about an hour. And then came the wait times. The "Energy" is regained SO slowly. You can get back after an hour and be able to get, like, 15 items? Which lets you make maybe 1/1024 of the next needed item? It's no longer worth it, if the gameplay time is shorter than the loading time. With the way the progress looks like, no amount of money could buy you more than an hour more of fun.

I was enjoying this for a while, and now I'm to the pottery. It's such a waste, I've been ignoring the orders with pottery because it's impossible to not spend money in order to get the right item/merge tree items. The pottery specifically isn't the issue, it's the lack of ability to fill orders with so little energy. I think 50 energy for leveling up anywhere above level 20 is such a small prize for a big feat (it takes forever). I hope the devs fix this and I'll play more again.

Fine game, but tragically formulated to make you pay. No ads is nice, except that in order to play for more than a few minutes, you need to buy energy with premium currency, and the cost doubles every time you buy. You keep your head above water for the first few levels but at a certain point you simply cannot play further without waiting hours, or paying. The worst part is, if there was an option to watch ads for energy, it would be totally fine, but you only get to once for 1/4th your reserve.

Fun to kill time but too slow to level up / create items to fill orders. Lots of bugs too. Random item spawn is a bit harsh when it's a tough order that doesn't pay/reward much. It kind of makes me not want to play when I lose motivation for completing an order or a collection. Please give your players a little more incentive or make leveling up a little more accessible so that its actually worth playing more. No, I don't mean selling us packages.

I really do enjoy this game but there are some things I wish were different. Wish the energy was a little easier to get without spending a ton of real money. Some items are just crazy to obtain for a little reward. The coins it takes to upgrade stuff in town once you get up levels are too high. Even if you played for a few days straight, you still hardly have enough to upgrade one level of a building. The cards, I have 47 duplicates but never seem to complete more than 2 or 3 albums.

Initially, I loved the game. But as you level up, it's almost impossible to complete orders in less than a day. The producers, mainly the fish net and sewing machine (so far), use an extraordinary amount of energy and rarely produce some items. I've spent a lot of money on this game and it doesn't help! 3 out of 4 of my current orders require red dress items, I've used THOUSANDS of energy/gems this week and still struggle to get them. I should just stop wasting my money and delete the game.

Fun at first but the game quickly bottlenecks. After about level 20, you only get a few orders of very high level items that take way too long to build to. The bigger issue is that you rarely get any tools which completely blocks progress. I have over 9,000 gold and I can't progress at all because I'm not getting any building materials. Also, a very unbalanced game. They only give you orders for the newest item generators you have, so the old item generators just sit on the board without use.

Tbh I played this game SO MUCH!! And I hate merging games. This one kept me occupied for months though!! 😊 It's kind of annoying when you can't progress because of your full screen though. And sometimes you need something that requires SO MANY ITEMS TO MERGE that you're tempted to keep them "just in case" some dumb character decides to ask for one of these hard to get items. Would be nice to stop having requests for old things from old levels

Has a lot of potential as it is a very entertaining game, however it devolves into a complete pay-to-play around Level 20. There is no way to gain energy or other in-game items unless you pay real money for them, which I hope none of yall are dumb enough to do. I also wish the devs would allow for upgrading appliances to have lower cooldowns and produce more lucky items. Preferably without having to pay stupid amounts of real life money. You have a good game, don't stop short for money

Only 3 stars for now, because while I love playing this game, it frustrates me no end when I have energy built up and then all the producing items go on orange recharge! I don't mind green, that's fine. It's short and I can do other things in the game while I wait. But when it orange recharges, it essentially shuts my game down for several hours because there's nothing to do! And it seems like the higher I level up, the less times I can merge before I get an orange recharge. PLEASE fix it!!

The newest updates have made the game pointless. Changing our coin rewards to chests is unfair. Taking away auto orders on things. It also seems harder the last few days to make orders. The things you need are coming less and less. I'm all for spending money on games occasionally, but not when it is impossible to progress unless you do. For those of us on higher levels, you have made it impossible to complete the daily goals without spending money. How is that fun?

I was having a lot of fun with this in the beginning, but the RNG at the higher levels is just ridiculous. Sometimes will take 3-4 days to complete one order. It feels like I get everything I don't need. Not being able to get rid of lower level generators no longer being used is also problematic. Only reason to expand storage is for stuff you can't use. Again, it was fun.. not anymore.

Was super fun until level 20'ish paywall. Basically if you want to play this more than 5 minutes daily you'll end up spending minimum $10 or more a week. I hate when games like this get greedy. I don't mind spending about $5-10 a month, but $40-$50 is way too exorbitant. I would imagine the game difficulty just keeps going up and you'd end up spending even more. Who knows. I'm out. There's another similar game I play where at least you can earn energy through ads. It's a good balance.

They should have left the bubbles the way they used to be, giving energy instead of coins. Also I think it would be better to have more than 3 peoples orders to try and complete at a time. It could help clear the board faster. Also the storage is an issue, either give more spaces or give us the option to delete areas that are complete or not needed any longer. Please make some new updates, cause the last ones sucked!

The longer you play this game, the more frustrated feeling you'll get. At the beginning it was very soothing and I enjoyed playing it a lot. But later on it just gets way too difficult to complete the task. The chance to get the item you want from generator is super low, so you need to keep tapping and consume your energy very fast. Took me several hours just to wait for being able to play for two minutes, and usually still couldn't get what I need for task.... it's just very frustrating.

Pro: the game is fun, and the storyline is somewhat interesting - made more so by the fact that the story unfolds through a unique group chat format. Con: after going up a few levels, it gets REALLY hard to play without spending $$$. 100 energy isn't abnormal for merge games, but there aren't many energy rewards here. Getting materials for upgrades is very hard, and they just reward XP. There's also no way to get enough energy to complete even half of the daily tasks; even after spending $$$.

The game keeps shutting off after I open it and start playing. Edit. Still no help. I emailed. I'm going to end up asking for a refund from Google. Edit. It seems like with every single update or addition you put on the game, it screws everything up and it starts glitching and turning off. Not giving you the progress you've made because it shuts down in the middle of it. I've spent money, and this continuing problem is going to make me get a refund. This is ridiculous because of it's frequency

I started with high rating. But everything changed. The rewards has been decreased a lot. You can play a few minutes, than you finish energy and to get new you need to use diamonds, which also finish very fast. Than you have to buy more. I didn't mind to spend little amounts like in every game, but they asked more and more. Cannot spend so much. The result is that cannot complete any task, cannot finish the albums or other events, losing the funniest part. Now it is just boring. No motivation.

I like the game but..like the reviews before mine, orders take a long time to complete with so little energy. They do have chances for watching adds to get more but you can only do it 3 times in 24 hours. And even then, you can't complete the orders. It takes days of coming back. Plus with this last event the winter one I really enjoyed having another board to play with. But I made it to level 10 and didn't get any event reward. What's the point of playing the event if you don't give rewards!

The game is very responsive and fun to play. There is no lag when merging and the graphics and colors are pleasing to look at. My biggest issue with this game, and the reason it's getting 2 stars is simply that there appears to be a disconnect between the developers and their customer base. The good packs for energy and gems are locked behind a pricey pay wall. $17.99 if I run out of energy is a huge amount to pay for a merge game and the rewards spend too fast to be worth it. I'd rather see ads

It's fun at the very beginning. But it became harder and harder to fulfill the orders if you getting higher level. Sometimes, you have to get a level 10 object to produce another object to fulfill orders. And this happens a lot when you getting higher level. It costs too many energy and you still can't fulfill one order. Moreover, after updating two times, the coins you needed to complete one level increases from thousands to around 60 thousands. It makes me frustrated about the upgrade.

Not completely a fan of the recent update. The bubbles release coins instead of lightning energy. And level increases releases 100 lightning/energy instead of a box we can release as we need it. It makes it more difficult and less fun. However, a benefit of the update is the fact that it doesn't close other open apps as much anymore. It used to close my podcast app and my blue screen filter app everytime I would try to play the game. Now it doesn't happen as much. Much appreciated.

A fun game. But to chime in on all the other reviews it's so hard to complete an order. The energy it takes to get one lottery item is insane. I don't even average 20 energy before I get one main item. I've bought a few starter packs/ and plenty of diamonds still takes too long. The wait time is also too long compared to how fast you get energy. Great graphics/ great idea but taking way too long to complete tasks. Storage is limited and board is constantly full.

The game is fun, but as you go along your board is so full of item generators that there's hardly any room to merge items. On top of that, some generate more than one type of item, but one item more frequently than the other so you end up wasting a bunch of energy on items you don't need trying to get the ones you do. To top it off, the app is constantly closing itself. It's starting to get extremely frustrating that I can barely play for two seconds without the app restarting.

Loved it at first but becoming extremely frustrated. Progress at higher levels becomes extremely slow and/or expensive. It seems that every update is designed to slow things down, make things harder or simply increase the pressure to pay to play. It doesn't work! If I enjoy the game, I spend real money. If I can't get anywhere without spending, the game gets deleted - that point is getting closer and closer.

Overall, not a bad merge game. The gameplay is easy and fun and the art style is nice. The story is also fairly decent as well. I only wish there was a an easier way to obtain energy without buying it or leveling up. The later you get into the game, the harder items the characters request for you to merge. With only 100 energy every so often it does take quite a long while to make these items. Perhaps increasing the max energy you can have as you get to a certain level could help with that?

Hopefully the new update fixes whatever bug is in the game that keeps saying "connection lost". I've never had an issue with losing internet connection on a game, ever, and I will complete orders or get objects I need then it blinks "connection lost" and have to close it out and when I come back I'm at square one again every time! Objects should restart after so many hours, instead of having to hit them till they turn yellow, there's not enough room on the board for that. I quit playing daily.

The concept is really cute but all in all falls a little flat for me. For starters, once you're past the first few levels, 100 energy really doesn't go far especially considering how much you need to match in order to get the items you need. "Locked" bonus items in bubbles say you can either pay to unlock or wait, but if you wait they just turn into a coin. The game also takes very long to load and sometimes crashes multiple times before opening

It was great at first and I managed to get through several of levels but now instead of being challenging it has become annoying. It takes ages to settle a task and to get the items especially the rare ones is so frustrating. Not to mention the energies being wasted to get it. At times you don't get those items at all. I just lost the interest and thinking of uninstalling it. Now it's just waste if time when no task can be resolved.

I never had a real problem with this game. I didn't mind waiting however long for a recharge of energy. The game ran pretty smooth until recently. It loads up and before I can make the first move, it freezes. I closed the game and reopened, reconnected to wifi,restarted my phone, but nothing helped. Every other app on my phone works fine. I've gotten pretty far with this game and I don't want to have to delete it, but it looks like thats going to be the case. :(

I've been playing for a few months and it's pretty fun, I can complete the daily quests most days and only bought one small diamond pack after playing daily for a while. This would be five stars, except that a few weeks, maybe a month ago, I started having an issue where I was watch an ad for a reward (either a bubble item or extra energy) and about half the time I just don't get the reward after the ad plays, instead the buttons get grayed out and it just continues as though I hadn't watched it

updated review: they actually listen and fix their issues and rewarded us to keep us. worth the praise. thank you. It was fun for many months. but now you need a trillion merges to produce an item to produce another item? that's ridiculous. its not even guaranteed. Also, after the last event, I don't have the option to sell or delete the temporary items. It's waiting space on the board. I will spend $ if it's worth it but it's not anymore.

They've really messed this up over the last year. Bubbles no longer give energy when they pop, item requests are all so far down the merge chain (or subchain!) after a point that it takes weeks to finish one and makes it hard to advance (this is the biggest problem), generator storage doesn't include all generators, bad changes to daily tasks. It was fine before. I don't understand this. Positive change are the events - lots of different ones, very creative. I enjoy those.

at the beginning, you don't need in app purchases and it's fun. But Once you get above level 22 it takes a lot longer to get the items you need to progress through the map, the only way to speed it up is by spending diamonds and it's slow to get them just through independent game play. So if you want to level up quicker either just have to be really patient, or start spending money on buying diamonds.

It's an okay game if you just need something to pass a couple of minutes but as you get higher levels there is minimal progress without spending money. All of the orders are for high level rare items so it takes way too long to actually achieve anything. They also lowered their rewards so it makes it even slower. Was fun before they made it a cash grab game.

I love the game, but please change the pottery one! As other reviewers have said, it is extremely frustrating to make one simple tile using so much energy...only for it to end up as a failed tile! And the same with the pot. I've spent days making one tile for an order only for the next to be an order for another high level tile 🙄. It should be more enjoyable to play the free version without spending money.

yeah pretty addictive game honestly but yes way to hard. instead of make it easier and fun I find myself playing for 1 minutes and need to wait 30 minutes for another 1 minute playing. also I really want to pay for something but hard to believe its legit

I started with absolutely loving this game. Waiting for the notification for my energy to be full and play it every day. I'm lv26 now and instead of it being relaxing, it's stressful and annoying. I have 4 spots left on the board, and my bag is full. I have a lot of left over energy but everything goes into extreme long cooldowns so I have to wait a long time. It would be best to get a new board eventually with new quests, because this is super chaotic when you need so many high lvl items.

I love the game although it keeps on crashing everytime I level up. I am tempted to uninstall because of it crashing constantly. As for energy, it would be nice to at least earn energy more easily by either increasing the times that ads can be watched to gain energy, or through continuous achievement goals. Instead of playing for 2 minutes and waiting for 3 hours to regain all the energy. Also it would be great to increase the limit of energy every level, instead of just getting chests.

Been my all time favorite game for so long, but now you have ruined it. You have made SO many changes and opportunities for us to earn energy, just so you can encourage players to make purchases to increase your profits. GREEDY! Now I can hardly ever play. You also have levels leading to requests that take DAYS to complete an order. Given how little energy we have to work with, that takes all the fun out of the game when progress is so slow. Fix this, and fix the lack of storage issue!!!

It's fun at first, but then you have too many item generators. Each gen. gives you more than one type of item, but it gives you more OF ONE type, so you waste energy getting items you don't need, trying to find the lesser given items to earn coins to advance. None of your tools improve when you level up, like the size of the board or the energy meter, so the game gets harder w/o you getting better. Plus, it gives you a hint after 1 second of inactivity, & you can't turn it off. Annoying pulsing

Edit: The events are no longer contributing to the collection, making the events almost impossible to complete!! Is this a bug?? - So I really love this game!! BUT I'm giving it only 4 stars.. Reason for this is that as the game progresses (and I'm only at level 29) the orders keep repeating over and over.. So you're basically merging the same stuff over and over for weeks on end and the rewards are small... And if that doesn't change, I might just get really bored with the game...

I've been playing this game for months and had loved it. With the newest update, it's impossible to get enough energy to get anything done. It's very difficult to complete 4 orders for the day (and with my current orders, I haven't filled any in 2 days). The bubbles just give coins now and leveling up gives you very little. The events also have useless prizes now, making it not worth it to play the event. Very disappointing because this last "upgrade" was very much a downgrade.

Congrats on driving away everyone who's not willing to shell out. Most of us would be willing to watch more ads for energy, but no, you cap those. The orders take weeks to fulfill once you get to higher levels, which means the story stagnates because you can't progress. I get like 3 minutes of playtime every few hours. It's not balanced at all. Finally uninstalled because it was stressing me out. This is too much.

Fun little mindless idle matching game with a silly NPC text chat and a town to build up. Not ad-heavy, which is a refreshment compared to other games out now. Cons: there's a long load time and it's laggy for the first minute each time you open it. Some of the ads do freeze the game to where you have to force close it, but that might be the ads themselves and not the game's programming. Also, the tooltip text for the Tool Boxes are incomplete. Overall pretty good.

I agree with the other reviews. You should receive more energy as you go along. You waste so much on trying to get the one item made that it takes days to complete and it's just annoying at that point. Example the cooking items. One, you press it 8 times or something close and it has to recharge so you wait forever to be able to press it another 8 times and it takes forever to get what you need then you probably won't get it the same day

Energy takes very long to fully charge... about 3 hours which you quickly use up. Constant adds for packages pop up whenever you run out of Energy, which happens constantly. In the higher levels, it takes a very long time to fulfill orders because you have to work on multiple things which require lots of energy. I feel like this game is designed for you to spend real money on it, and lots thereof, instead of really having fun, which a game should be about.

Tried for Fe*ch but turns out I actually love this game it's really cute and fun. A super simple merging game. Not bombarded by ads. The beachy theme is really nice, love the representation in the characters too. Lovely art style. If I come across anything super annoying after more playing I will update my review. Edit: I wish there were more opportunities to watch ads in exchange for energy and such. It does but only like 4 times a day or something. I'd watch a lot of ads, I love this game!

Upon discovering the ability to save my progress, it wiped out the current level I was on as well as the 103,000+ coins and brought me back to level one. Support was notified and I've yet to hear from anyone. Update: not only did I get screwed out of my progress from the first game, now there's no way for me to continue my 2nd game because it keeps freezing and claiming "connection lost" when there's nothing wrong with my internet. Unbelievable.

Its a really enjoyable game to play but then you run out of energy after two minutes. Watch a couple of ads to get more energy, no problem but then that option stops becoming available. I never spend money on a game that makes it difficult to progress without doing so. This is such a lovely game but I can see it being deleted soon due to the fact I can't play it for as long as I'd like.

takes too much energy to complete orders after a couple weeks of playing. the game itself is ok but it gets boring so fast because of this issue. great idea but you can tell they don't really care about the players because they can't keep it interesting. I can use my whole recharged energy bar 3 times and still not complete an order. if I could give 0 stars I would.
Actually I'm obsessed with this game, and people around me says that I'm addicted. yes ofcourse, but recently its frustrating to get cards, win the events, I'm losing some events in the last minute.

I used to LOVE this game. I never minded purchasing energy/jewels from to help me along. However, once I hit the pet part, I have LOATHED the game. They do not give you enough of either the cat or dog supplies (they're always just one off). It clutters up the board CONSTANTLY. It's no longer fun. The latest graphic updates are super ugly. They don't match well w/ the previous art that was sleek & well done. Also super unhappy the side game is now dependent on fulfilling orders in the main game.

Edit: issues were swiftly resolved, very happy with customer service! I uninstalled and reinstalled the game to start over and now all it is saying is connection lost even though I have cell phone signal and Wi-Fi. It's very disappointing because this was one of my favorite games to play whenever I would have anxiety. If this gets fixed I'll rerate

I really liked the game, and if they can fix the issue of the game closing mid play all the time i would rate it a 5. Also I was at level 52, and I cleared cache, and data in a effort to have the game play without shutting down, and when I logged back in, I was now at level 20. I'll be deleting the game for now, will check back to see if the issues has been fixed. Please fix I lived this game.

This is one of the best merge games out there - the price to expand storage, pop bubbles, and progress the game is significantly less than others on the market. The events are actually achievable, and you never need to spend real money to get far. The time it takes to refill energy is also less than other games I've played, which is really nice. Overall it's well crafted, but of course still a way to make money through microtransactions. Definitely recommend for a relaxing merge game!

I'm sorry but I had to change my review. it became money driven. the more real money you spent the more difficult it becomes. the sebum card collection is just a bunch of duplicates and its very difficult to finish the album. when I contact support it's just a copy and paste message. same reply about duplicates happening "occasionally ", players must use trading platforms (which I do), complete challenges (which I do and only get duplicates) and of cause the one they love, use money to buy extra

I liked this game at first, but as you go along, it requires too much energy to get the things you need. You end up just wasting energy. Plus, the energy takes waaayyy too long to charge back up, but it's used up so fast. You end up not being able to complete tasks days later. I dont think this game is worth it, and it's a waste of time. I think I'm just going to uninstall.

Game's great, but I feel like it lost something after the update where all the levels were changed. Now getting coins takes forever and certain items rarely drop (took me 2wks for the red dress).
